			return
		end

		t4.isViewing = false
		t4.viewingEnded:Fire(true)
		t4:setState(nil, "User", t4)
	end

	t4.joinedParent:Connect(function()
		if not t4.isViewing then
			return
		end

		if t4.locked then
			return
		end

		t4.isViewing = false
		t4.viewingEnded:Fire(true)
		t4:setState(nil, "User", t4)
	end)
	v56.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		local u282: boolean = v5.PreferredInput ~= t3.desktop

		if t4.locked then
			return
		end

		t4.isViewing = true
		t4.viewingStarted:Fire(true)

		if not u282 then
			t4:setState("Viewing", "User", t4)
		end
	end)

	local n3: number = 0

	v54:add(v5.TouchEnded:Connect(viewingEnded))
	v56.MouseLeave:Connect(viewingEnded)
	v56.SelectionGained:Connect(function(p10)
		if t4.locked then
			return
		end

		t4.isViewing = true
		t4.viewingStarted:Fire(true)

		if not p10 then
			t4:setState("Viewing", "User", t4)
		end
	end)
	v56.SelectionLost:Connect(viewingEnded)
	v56.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		if not t4.locked and v5.PreferredInput == t3.mobile then
			n3 += 1

			local v284: number = n3

			task.delay(0.2, function()
				if v284 ~= n3 then
					return
				end

				if t4.locked then
					return
				end

				t4.isViewing = true
				t4.viewingStarted:Fire(true)
				t4:setState("Viewing", "User", t4)
			end)
		end
	end)
	v56.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		n3 += 1
	end)

	local v63 = t4:getInstance("IconOverlay")

	t4.viewingStarted:Connect(function()
		v63.Visible = not t4.overlayDisabled
	end)
	t4.viewingEnded:Connect(function()
		v63.Visible = false
	end)
	v54:add(v23:Connect(function(p11)
		if p11 ~= t4 and t4.deselectWhenOtherIconSelected and p11.deselectWhenOtherIconSelected then
			t4:deselect("AutoDeselect", p11)
		end
	end))

	local v64 = debug.info(2, "s")
	local parts = string.split(v64, ".")
	local v66 = game
	local v67 = nil

	for _, v in pairs(parts) do
		v66 = v66:FindFirstChild(v)

		if not v66 then
			break
		end

		if v66:IsA("ScreenGui") then
			v67 = v66
		end
	end

	if v66 and v67 and v67.ResetOnSpawn == true then
		t4.originsScreenGui = v67
		v15.localPlayerRespawned(function()
			t4:destroy()
		end)
	end

	t4.toggled:Connect(function(p12)
		t4.noticeChanged:Fire(t4.totalNotices)

		for k, _ in pairs(t4.childIconsDict) do
			local v289 = module.getIconByUID(k)

			v289.noticeChanged:Fire(v289.totalNotices)

			if not p12 and v289.isSelected then
				for _, _ in pairs(v289.childIconsDict) do
					v289:deselect("HideParentFeature", t4)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	t4.selected:Connect(function()
		if #t4.dropdownIcons > 0 then
			if starterGui:GetCore("ChatActive") and t4.alignment ~= "Right" then
				t4.chatWasPreviouslyActive = true
				starterGui:SetCore("ChatActive", false)
			end

			if starterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled("PlayerList") and t4.alignment ~= "Left" then
				t4.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive = true
				starterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, false)
			end
		end
	end)
	t4.deselected:Connect(function()
		if t4.chatWasPreviouslyActive then
			t4.chatWasPreviouslyActive = nil
			starterGui:SetCore("ChatActive", true)
		end

		if t4.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive then
			t4.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive = nil
			starterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, true)
		end
	end)
	task.delay(0.1, function()
		if t4.activeState == "Deselected" then
			t4.stateChanged:Fire("Deselected")
			t4:refresh()
		end
	end)
	module.iconAdded:Fire(t4)

	return t4
end

function module.setState(p15, p16: string, p17, p18)
	if not p16 then
		p16 = if p15.isSelected then "Selected" else "Deselected"
	end

	local v76 = v15.formatStateName(p16)

	if p15.activeState == v76 then
		return
	end

	local isSelected = p15.isSelected

	p15.activeState = v76

	if v76 == "Deselected" then
		p15.isSelected = false

		if isSelected then
			p15.toggled:Fire(false, p17, p18)
			p15.deselected:Fire(p17, p18)
		end

		p15:_setToggleItemsVisible(false, p17, p18)
	elseif v76 == "Selected" then
		p15.isSelected = true

		if not isSelected then
			p15.toggled:Fire(true, p17, p18)
			p15.selected:Fire(p17, p18)
			v23:Fire(p15, p17, p18)
		end

		p15:_setToggleItemsVisible(true, p17, p18)
	end

	p15.stateChanged:Fire(v76, p17, p18)
end
function module.getInstance(p19, p20)
	local v80 = p19.cachedNamesToInstances[p20]

	if v80 then
		return v80
	end

	local function cacheInstance(p21, p22)
		if not p19.cachedInstances[p22] then
			local collective = p22:GetAttribute("Collective")
			local v295 = collective and p19.cachedCollectives[collective]

			if v295 then
				table.insert(v295, p22)
			end

			p19.cachedNamesToInstances[p21] = p22
			p19.cachedInstances[p22] = true
			p22.Destroying:Once(function()
				p19.cachedNamesToInstances[p21] = nil
				p19.cachedInstances[p22] = nil
			end)
		end
	end

	local widget = p19.widget

	cacheInstance("Widget", widget)

	if p20 == "Widget" then
		return widget
	end

	local u83 = nil

	local function scanChildren(p23)
		for _, v in pairs(p23:GetChildren()) do
			local widgetUID = v:GetAttribute("WidgetUID")

			if not widgetUID or widgetUID == p19.UID then
				local v300 = v16.getRealInstance(v)

				if v300 then
					v = v300
				end

				scanChildren(v)

				if v:IsA("GuiBase") or v:IsA("UIBase") or v:IsA("ValueBase") then
					local vName = v.Name

					cacheInstance(vName, v)

					if vName == p20 then
						u83 = v
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	scanChildren(widget)

	return u83
end
function module.getCollective(p24, p25)

	if v87 then
		return v87

	v87 = {}

	for k, _ in pairs(p24.cachedInstances) do
		local collective = k:GetAttribute("Collective")

		if p25 == collective then
			table.insert(v87, k)
		end
	end

	p24.cachedCollectives[p25] = v87

	return v87
end

function module.align(p80, p81, p82)
	local lowerText = tostring(p81):lower()

	if lowerText == "mid" or lowerText == "centre" then
		lowerText = "center"
	end

	if lowerText ~= "left" and lowerText ~= "center" and lowerText ~= "right" then
		lowerText = "left"
	end

	local v161 = lowerText == "center" and module.container.TopbarCentered or module.container.TopbarStandard
	local holders = v161.Holders
	local stringUpper = string.upper
	local v164 = string.sub(lowerText, 1, 1)
	local v165 = stringUpper(v164)

	v164 = string.sub(lowerText, 2)

	local s1: string = v165 .. v164

	if not p82 then
		p80.originalAlignment = s1
	end

	local joinedFrame = p80.joinedFrame

	v164 = holders[s1]
	p80.screenGui = v161
	p80.alignmentHolder = v164

	if not p80.isDestroyed then
		p80.widget.Parent = joinedFrame or v164
	end

	p80.alignment = s1
	p80.alignmentChanged:Fire(s1)
	module.iconChanged:Fire(p80)

	return p80
end

function module.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p160, p161, p162)
	task.defer(function()
		local v304 = p160:getInstance("IconLabel")

		v304.Transparency = 1
		p161.Parent = v304.Parent
		p161.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		p161.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		p161.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
		p161.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		p161.ClipsDescendants = false

		for _, v in ipairs({
			"FontFace",
			"BorderSizePixel",
			"BorderColor3",
			"Rotation",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextStrokeColor3",
			"TextStrokeTransparency",
			"TextColor3"
		}) do
			p161[v] = v304[v]

			local v307 = v304:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v)

			p160:addToJanitor(v307:Connect(function()
				p161[v] = v304[v]
			end))
		end

		local function getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount()
			local n1 = 0
			local n2: number = 0

			for iterFirst, iterSecond in p161.Frame:GetChildren() do
				local lowerText = string.lower(iterSecond.Name)

				if lowerText == "digit" or (lowerText == "prefix" or lowerText == "suffix" or lowerText == "comma") and iterSecond.Text ~= "" then
					n1 += iterSecond.AbsoluteSize.X
					n2 += 1
				end
			end

			return n1, n2
		end
		local function getLabelParentContainerXSize()
			local v317 = v304.Parent
			local v318 = v317 and v317.Parent

			if v318 == nil then
				return 0
			end

			if v318.IconImage.Visible == true then
				return p161.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X + v304.Parent.Parent.IconImage.AbsoluteSize.X
			end

			return v318.AbsoluteSize.X
		end
		local function getNumberSpinnerXSize()
			return p161.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X
		end
		local function adjustSize()
			local v319, v320 = getSpinnerSizeAndDigitCount()

			if v320 < 18 then
				p160:setLabel(p161.Value)
			end

			local v321 = p161.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X

			while v319 < v321 and p160.isDestroyed ~= true do
				task.wait(0.05)

				if v320 > 0 and v320 < 8 then

function module.prototype.cancel(p103)

		return

	if p103._parent then
		p103._parent:_consumerCancelled(p103)
	end

	for iterKey in pairs(p103._consumers) do
		iterKey:cancel()
	end

	p103:_finalize()
end

		typedat = p8,
		rawGoal = p7
	}, t1))
end
function t1.setGoal(p9, p10)
	p9.rawGoal = p10
	p9.g = p9.typedat.toIntermediate(p10)
end
function t1.setDampingRatio(p11, p12)
	p11.d = p12
end
function t1.setFrequency(p13, p14)
	p13.f = p14
end
function t1.canSleep(p15)
	local n1 = 0

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in p15.v, nil, nil do
		n1 += iterSecond ^ 2
	end

	if n1 > 0.0001 then
		return false
	end

	local g = p15.g

	n1 = 0

	for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in p15.p, nil, nil do
		n1 += (g[iterFirst2] - iterSecond2) ^ 2
	end

	if n1 > 6.781684027777778E-8 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end
function t1.step(p16, p17)
	local d = p16.d
	local n1 = p16.f * 6.283185307179586
	local g = p16.g
	local p = p16.p
	local v = p16.v

	if d == 1 then
		local v75 = mathExp(-n1 * p17)
		local n2 = p17 * v75

		for i = 1, #p do
			local n3 = p[i] - g[i]

			p[i] = n3 * (v75 + n2 * n1) + v[i] * n2 + g[i]
			v[i] = v[i] * (v75 - n2 * n1) - n3 * (n2 * n1 * n1)
		end
	elseif d < 1 then
		local v79 = mathExp(-d * n1 * p17)
		local v80 = mathSqrt(1 - d * d)
		local v81 = mathCos(p17 * n1 * v80)
		local v82 = mathSin(p17 * n1 * v80)
		local n4 = p17 * n1
		local n5 = if v80 > 0.00001 then v82 / v80 else n4 + (n4 * n4 * (v80 * v80) * (v80 * v80) / 20 - v80 * v80) * (n4 * n4 * n4) / 6
		local n6

		if n1 * v80 > 0.00001 then
			n6 = v82 / (n1 * v80)
		else
			local n7 = n1 * v80

			n6 = p17 + (p17 * p17 * (n7 * n7) * (n7 * n7) / 20 - n7 * n7) * (p17 * p17 * p17) / 6
		end

		for i = 1, #p do
			local n8 = p[i] - g[i]

			p[i] = (n8 * (v81 + n5 * d) + v[i] * n6) * v79 + g[i]
			v[i] = (v[i] * (v81 - n5 * d) - n8 * (n5 * n1)) * v79
		end
	else
		local v89 = mathSqrt(d * d - 1)
		local n9 = -n1 * (d + v89)
		local n10 = -n1 * (d - v89)
		local v92 = mathExp(n9 * p17)
		local v93 = mathExp(n10 * p17)

		for i = 1, #p do
			local n11 = p[i] - g[i]
			local n12 = (v[i] - n11 * n9) / (2 * n1 * v89)
			local n13 = v92 * (n11 - n12)

			p[i] = n13 + n12 * v93 + g[i]
			v[i] = n13 * n9 + n12 * v93 * n10
		end
	end

	return p16.typedat.fromIntermediate(p16.p)
end

local t2: {[any]: any} = {}

function t2.new(p18, p19, p20, p21)
	local v102 = p21:Orthonormalize()
	local v103 = p20:Orthonormalize()

	return (setmetatable({ v = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), d = p18, f = p19, g = v102, p = v103 }, t2))
end
function t2.setGoal(p22, p23)
	p22.g = p23:Orthonormalize()
end
function t2.setDampingRatio(p24, p25)
	p24.d = p25

function t2.setFrequency(p26, p27)
	p26.f = p27

local function dot(p28, p29)
	return p28.X * p29.X + p28.Y * p29.Y + p28.Z * p29.Z
end
local function areRotationsClose(p30, p31)
	local xVector = p30.XVector
	local v115 = p31.XVector
	local yVector = p30.YVector
	local v117 = p31.YVector
	local zVector = p30.ZVector
	local v119 = p31.ZVector

	return xVector.X * v115.X + xVector.Y * v115.Y + xVector.Z * v115.Z + (yVector.X * v117.X + yVector.Y * v117.Y + yVector.Z * v117.Z) + (zVector.X * v119.X + zVector.Y * v119.Y + zVector.Z * v119.Z) > 2.9999999695382584
end
local function angleDiff(p32, p33)
	local xVector = p32.XVector
	local v123 = p33.XVector
	local yVector = p32.YVector
	local v125 = p33.YVector
	local zVector = p32.ZVector
	local v127 = p33.ZVector
	local n1 = xVector.X * v123.X + xVector.Y * v123.Y + xVector.Z * v123.Z + (yVector.X * v125.X + yVector.Y * v125.Y + yVector.Z * v125.Z) + (zVector.X * v127.X + zVector.Y * v127.Y + zVector.Z * v127.Z) - 1
	local v129 = mathMax(0, 1 - n1 * n1 * 0.25)
	local v130 = mathSqrt(v129)

	return (mathAtan2(v130, n1 * 0.5))
end
local function fromAxisAngle(p34, p35)
	local v133 = mathCos(p35)
	local v134 = mathSin(p35)
	local x = p34.X
	local y = p34.Y
	local z = p34.Z
	local n1 = x * y * (1 - v133)
	local n2 = y * z * (1 - v133)
	local n3 = z * x * (1 - v133)
	local vector3 = Vector3.new(x * x * (1 - v133) + v133, n1 + z * v134, n3 - y * v134)
	local vector32 = Vector3.new(n1 - z * v134, y * y * (1 - v133) + v133, n2 + x * v134)
	local vector33 = Vector3.new(n3 + y * v134, n2 - x * v134, z * z * (1 - v133) + v133)

	return CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), vector3, vector32, vector33):Orthonormalize()
end
local function rotateAxis(p36, p37)
	local v146 = CFrame.identity
	local magnitude = p36.Magnitude

	if magnitude > 0.000001 then
		v146 = fromAxisAngle(p36.Unit, magnitude)
	end

	return v146 * p37
end
local function axisAngleDiff(p38, p39)
	local v150 = p39:Inverse()
	local v151 = (p38 * v150):ToAxisAngle()

	v150 = angleDiff(p38, p39)

	return v151.Unit * v150
end
function t2.canSleep(p40)
	local p = p40.p
	local g = p40.g
	local pXVector = p.XVector
	local gXVector = g.XVector
	local pYVector = p.YVector
	local gYVector = g.YVector
	local pZVector = p.ZVector
	local gZVector = g.ZVector

	return pXVector.X * gXVector.X + pXVector.Y * gXVector.Y + pXVector.Z * gXVector.Z + (pYVector.X * gYVector.X + pYVector.Y * gYVector.Y + pYVector.Z * gYVector.Z) + (pZVector.X * gZVector.X + pZVector.Y * gZVector.Y + pZVector.Z * gZVector.Z) > 2.9999999695382584 and p40.v.Magnitude < 0.0017453292519943296
end
function t2.step(p41, p42)
	local d = p41.d
	local n1 = p41.f * 6.283185307179586
	local g = p41.g
	local p = p41.p
	local v = p41.v
	local v168 = g:Inverse()
	local v169 = (p * v168):ToAxisAngle()

	v168 = angleDiff(p, g)

	local n2 = v169.Unit * v168

	v169 = mathExp(-d * n1 * p42)

	local n3
	local n4

	if d == 1 then
		local n5 = (n2 * (1 + n1 * p42) + v * p42) * v169
		local v175 = CFrame.identity
		local magnitude = n5.Magnitude

		if magnitude > 0.000001 then
			v175 = fromAxisAngle(n5.Unit, magnitude)
		end

		n3 = v175 * g
		n4 = (v * (1 - p42 * n1) - n2 * (p42 * n1 * n1)) * v169
	elseif d < 1 then
		local v177 = mathSqrt(1 - d * d)
		local v178 = mathCos(p42 * n1 * v177)
		local v179 = mathSin(p42 * n1 * v177)
		local n6 = v179 / v177
		local n7 = (n2 * (v178 + n6 * d) + v * (v179 / (n1 * v177))) * v169
		local v181 = CFrame.identity
		local v182 = n7.Magnitude

		if v182 > 0.000001 then
			v181 = fromAxisAngle(n7.Unit, v182)
		end

		n3 = v181 * g
		n4 = (v * (v178 - n6 * d) - n2 * (n6 * n1)) * v169
	else
		local v183 = mathSqrt(d * d - 1)
		local n8 = -n1 * (d + v183)
		local n9 = -n1 * (d - v183)
		local n10 = (v - n2 * n8) / (2 * n1 * v183)
		local v186 = mathExp(n8 * p42)
		local n11 = (n2 - n10) * v186
		local v188 = mathExp(n9 * p42)

		v186 = n10 * v188
		v188 = n11 + v186

		local v189 = CFrame.identity
		local v190 = v188.Magnitude

		if v190 > 0.000001 then
			v189 = fromAxisAngle(v188.Unit, v190)
		end

		n3 = v189 * g
		n4 = n11 * n8 + v186 * n9
	end

	p41.p = n3
	p41.v = n4

	return n3
end

local function rgbToLuv(p61)
	local r = p61.R
	local n1 = r < 0.0404482362771076 and r / 12.92 or 0.87941546140213 * (r + 0.055) ^ 2.4
	local g = p61.G
	local n2 = g < 0.0404482362771076 and g / 12.92 or 0.87941546140213 * (g + 0.055) ^ 2.4
	local b = p61.B
	local n3 = b < 0.0404482362771076 and b / 12.92 or 0.87941546140213 * (b + 0.055) ^ 2.4
	local n4 = 0.2125862307855956 * n1 + 0.7151703037034108 * n2 + 0.0722004986433362 * n3
	local n5 = 3.6590806972265884 * n1 + 11.442689580057424 * n2 + 4.114991502426484 * n3
	local n6 = n4 > 0.008856451679035631 and 116 * n4 ^ 0.3333333333333333 - 16 or 903.296296296296 * n4
	local n7
	local n8

	if n5 > 1E-14 then
		n7 = n6 * (0.9257063972951867 * n1 - 0.8333736323779866 * n2 - 0.09209820666085898 * n3) / n5
		n8 = n6 * (9 * n4 / n5 - 0.46832)
	else
		n7 = -0.19783 * n6
		n8 = -0.46832 * n6
	end

	return { n6, n7, n8 }
end
local function luvToRgb(list)
	local v226 = list[1]

	if v226 < 0.0197955 then
		return Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end

	local n1 = list[2] / v226 + 0.19783
	local n2 = list[3] / v226 + 0.46832
	local n3 = (v226 + 16) / 116

	n3 = n3 > 0.20689655172413793 and n3 * n3 * n3 or n3 * 0.12841854934601665 - 0.01771290335807126

	local n4 = n3 * n1 / n2
	local n5 = n3 * ((3 - n1 * 0.75) / n2 - 5)
	local n6 = n4 * 7.2914074 - n3 * 1.537208 - n5 * 0.4986286
	local n7 = n4 * -2.180094 + n3 * 1.8757561 + n5 * 0.0415175
	local n8 = n4 * 0.1253477 - n3 * 0.2040211 + n5 * 1.0569959

	if n6 < 0 and n6 < n7 and n6 < n8 then
		n7 -= n6
		n8 -= n6
		n6 = 0
	elseif n7 < 0 and n7 < n8 then
		n6 -= n7
		n8 -= n7
		n7 = 0
	elseif n8 < 0 then
		n6 -= n8
		n7 -= n8
		n8 = 0
	end

	local color3New = Color3.new
	local v236 = mathMin(n6 < 0.0031306684425 and 12.92 * n6 or 1.055 * n6 ^ 0.4166666666666667 - 0.055, 1)
	local v237 = mathMin(n7 < 0.0031306684425 and 12.92 * n7 or 1.055 * n7 ^ 0.4166666666666667 - 0.055, 1)
	local v238 = mathMin(n8 < 0.0031306684425 and 12.92 * n8 or 1.055 * n8 ^ 0.4166666666666667 - 0.055, 1)

	return color3New(v236, v237, v238)
end

local function processSprings(p88, p89)
	for iterFirst, iterSecond in p88, nil, nil do
		for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in iterSecond, nil, nil do
			if iterSecond2:canSleep() then
				iterSecond[iterFirst2] = nil

				local rawGoal = iterSecond2.rawGoal
				local v289 = t11[iterFirst2]

				if v289 and iterFirst:IsA(v289.class) then
					v289.set(iterFirst, rawGoal)
				else
					iterFirst[iterFirst2] = rawGoal
				end
			else
				local v290 = iterSecond2:step(p89)
				local v291 = t11[iterFirst2]

				if v291 and iterFirst:IsA(v291.class) then
					v291.set(iterFirst, v290)
				else
					iterFirst[iterFirst2] = v290
				end
			end
		end

		if not next(iterSecond) then
			p88[iterFirst] = nil

			local v292 = t14[iterFirst]

			if v292 then
				t14[iterFirst] = nil

				for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in v292, nil, nil do
					task.spawn(iterSecond3)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	processSprings(t13, deltaTimeSim)
end)

	local typeName: string = typeof(p95)

	if not p94:find(typeName) then
		local typeName2: string = typeof(p95)
		local v303 = ("bad argument #%* to %* (%* expected, got %*)"):format(p92, p93, p94, typeName2)

		error(v303, 3)
	end
end

return table.freeze({
	target = function(p96, p97, p98, p99)
		if not ("Instance"):find((typeof(p96))) then
			local v308 = ("bad argument #%* to spr.target (Instance expected, got %*)"):format(1, (typeof(p96)))

			error(v308, 3)
		end

		if not ("number"):find((typeof(p97))) then
			local v309 = ("bad argument #%* to spr.target (number expected, got %*)"):format(2, (typeof(p97)))

			error(v309, 3)
		end

		if not ("number"):find((typeof(p98))) then
			local v310 = ("bad argument #%* to spr.target (number expected, got %*)"):format(3, (typeof(p98)))

			error(v310, 3)
		end

		if not ("table"):find((typeof(p99))) then
			local v311 = ("bad argument #%* to spr.target (table expected, got %*)"):format(4, (typeof(p99)))

			error(v311, 3)
		end

		if p97 ~= p97 or p97 < 0 then
			local v312 = ("expected damping ratio >= 0; got %.2f"):format(p97)

			error(v312, 2)
		end

		if p98 ~= p98 or p98 < 0 then
			local v313 = ("expected undamped frequency >= 0; got %.2f"):format(p98)

			error(v313, 2)
		end

		local v314: {[any]: any} = if p96:IsA("Camera") then t13 else t12
		local t15 = v314[p96]

		if not t15 then
			t15 = {}
			v314[p96] = t15
		end

		for iterFirst, iterSecond in p99, nil, nil do
			local v318 = t11[iterFirst]
			local v319 = if v318 and p96:IsA(v318.class) then v318.get(p96) else p96[iterFirst]
			local typeName: string = typeof(iterSecond)
			local typeName3: string = typeof(v319)

			if typeName ~= typeName3 then
				local typeName4: string = typeof(v319)
				local typeName5: string = typeof(iterSecond)
				local v324 = ("bad property %* to spr.target (%* expected, got %*)"):format(iterFirst, typeName4, typeName5)

				error(v324, 2)
			end

			if p98 == math.huge then
				local v325 = t11[iterFirst]

				if v325 and p96:IsA(v325.class) then
					v325.set(p96, iterSecond)
				else
					p96[iterFirst] = iterSecond
				end

				t15[iterFirst] = nil
			else
				local v326 = t15[iterFirst]

				if not v326 then
					local typeName6: string = typeof(iterSecond)
					local v328 = rotateAxis[typeName6]

					if not v328 then
						local typeName7: string = typeof(iterSecond)

						error("unsupported type: " .. typeName7, 2)
					end

					v326 = v328.springType(p97, p98, v319, iterSecond, v328)
					t15[iterFirst] = v326
				end

				v326:setGoal(iterSecond)
				v326:setDampingRatio(p97)
				v326:setFrequency(p98)

		end
	end

end

local transferOwnership = clanGUI.Pages.TransferOwnership
local transferConfirmation = clanGUI.Pages.TransferConfirmation

local function timeAgo(p46)
	local floored = math.floor(p46 / 60)
	local floored2 = math.floor(floored / 60)
	local floored3 = math.floor(floored2 / 24)
	local floored4 = math.floor(floored3 / 7)
	local floored5 = math.floor(floored3 / 30)
	local floored6 = math.floor(floored3 / 365)

	if p46 < 60 then
		return "just now"
	end

	if floored < 60 then
		return floored .. " minute(s) ago"
	end

	if floored2 < 24 then
		return floored2 .. " hour(s) ago"
	end

	if floored3 == 1 then
		return "yesterday"
	end

	if floored3 < 7 then
		return floored3 .. " day(s) ago"
	end

	if floored4 == 1 then
		return "a week ago"
	end

	if floored4 < 4 then
		return floored4 .. " week(s) ago"
	end

	if floored5 == 1 then
		return "a month ago"
	end

	if floored5 < 12 then
		return floored5 .. " month(s) ago"
	end

	if floored6 == 1 then
		return "a year ago"
	end

	return floored6 .. " year(s) ago"
end

		frame.Error.Text = ""
	end)
end

	end

		if p46 == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			emoteWheelWheel:SetAttribute("WheelPosition", UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.5))
		else
			emoteWheelWheel:SetAttribute("WheelPosition", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
		end

		if not emoteWheelWheel.Visible then
			emoteWheelWheel.Position = emoteWheelWheel:GetAttribute("WheelPosition")
		end

		setListPosition()
	end)

	if v8:GetLastInputType() == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		emoteWheelWheel:SetAttribute("WheelPosition", UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.5))
	else
		emoteWheelWheel:SetAttribute("WheelPosition", UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
	end

	emoteWheelWheel.Position = emoteWheelWheel:GetAttribute("WheelPosition")
	emoteWheelWheel.Pages.Next.Activated:Connect(function()
		module.page = module.page % 5 + 1
		module:updatePage()
	end)
	emoteWheelWheel.Pages.Previous.Activated:Connect(function()
		module.page = if module.page <= 1 then 5 else module.page - 1
		module:updatePage()
	end)
	v8.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, p48)
		if p48 then
			return
		end

		debug.profilebegin("get keycode")

		local keyCode = input.KeyCode

		debug.profileend()

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then
			module.page = module.page % 5 + 1
			module:updatePage()
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
			module.page = if module.page <= 1 then 5 else module.page - 1
			module:updatePage()
		end
	end)
	module:updatePage()
end

return module

local function updateHoverPosition()
	if not u27 then
		return
	end

	local v43 = v6:GetMouseLocation()
	local n1 = v43.X + 2
	local n2 = v43.Y + 10
	local v46 = guiService:GetGuiInset()
	local playerGuiHoverInfoAbsoluteSize = playerGuiHoverInfo.AbsoluteSize
	local playerGuiHoverInfoItemAbsoluteSize = playerGuiHoverInfoItem.AbsoluteSize
	local uDim2FromOffset = UDim2.fromOffset
	local n3 = n1 + (if n1 + playerGuiHoverInfoItemAbsoluteSize.X > playerGuiHoverInfoAbsoluteSize.X then -playerGuiHoverInfoItemAbsoluteSize.X else 0)
	local v51 = math.max(n2 + (if n2 + playerGuiHoverInfoItemAbsoluteSize.Y > playerGuiHoverInfoAbsoluteSize.Y then -playerGuiHoverInfoItemAbsoluteSize.Y else 0), v46.Y)

	playerGuiHoverInfoItem.Position = uDim2FromOffset(n3, v51)
end
local function stepUpdateObject()
	local v52 = if u27 then t1[u27] else nil

	if u27 and v52 then
		local item = v52.Item
		local itemTradeLock = item.TradeLock

		if itemTradeLock ~= nil and playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked.Visible then
			if item.IsCustom then
				if itemTradeLock.Type == "Permanent" then
					playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked.Text = "Untradable"

					return
				end

				if itemTradeLock.Type == "Trial" then
					playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked.Text = ("Trial for %*"):format((v10.ValueConvertor:FormatTimeWithDaysFull(playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked:GetAttribute("Timestamp"))))

					return
				end
			else
				if itemTradeLock.Type == "Permanent" then
					playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked.Text = "Untradable"

					return
				end

				if itemTradeLock.Type == "Date" then
					local playerGuiHoverInfoItemListLocked = playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked
					local valueConvertor = v10.ValueConvertor
					local timestamp = playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked:GetAttribute("Timestamp")
					local v58: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
					local v59 = math.max(timestamp - v58, 0)

					playerGuiHoverInfoItemListLocked.Text = ("Untradable (%*)"):format((valueConvertor:FormatTimeWithDaysFull(v59)))

					return
				end

				if itemTradeLock.Type == "Trial" then
					local locked = playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked
					local v61 = v10.ValueConvertor
					local timestamp = playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked:GetAttribute("Timestamp")
					local v63: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
					local v64 = math.max(timestamp - v63, 0)

					locked.Text = ("Untradable (Trial for %*)"):format((v61:FormatTimeWithDaysFull(v64)))

					return
				end

				if itemTradeLock.Type == "Listing" then
					playerGuiHoverInfoItemList.Locked.Text = "Untradable (listed in Booth)"
				end
			end

			return
		end

		return
	end
end
local function cropDescription(p2: string)
	if #p2 > 100 then
		local v66 = string.sub(p2, 101)
		local replacedText = string.sub(p2, 1, 100):gsub("(%W*)$", "")
		local v68 = v66:find("%W")
		local substring = v66:sub(1, (v68 or 1) - 1)

		p2 = replacedText .. substring .. "..."
	end

	return p2
end

local function setHovering(p3)
	if t1[p3] and p3 ~= u27 then
		u27 = p3
		updateHoverPosition()
		fullUpdateObject()
		playerGuiHoverInfoItem.Visible = u27 ~= nil

		return
	end
end
local function removeHovering(p4)
	if p4 ~= u27 then
		return
	end

	u27 = nil
	u34 = nil
	playerGuiHoverInfoItem.Visible = u27 ~= nil

	if playerGuiHoverInfoItem.Visible then
		fullUpdateObject()
	end
end
local function clearHovering()
	u27 = nil
	u34 = nil
	playerGuiHoverInfoItem.Visible = false
end

local function updateGuiObjects()
	local u113: boolean = true

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in t2, nil, nil do
		if iterSecond.Enabled then
			u113 = false

			break
		end
	end

	local v116 = v6:GetMouseLocation()

	updateHoverPosition()

	local guiObjects

	if u113 then
		local x = v116.X
		local y = v116.Y
		local v120 = guiService:GetGuiInset()

		guiObjects = PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(x, y - v120.Y)
	else
		guiObjects = {}
	end

	for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in guiObjects, nil, nil do
		if iterSecond2.Name == "SinkInput" then
			break
		end

		if t1[iterSecond2] and (not iterSecond2:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui") or iterSecond2:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui").AlwaysOnTop or iterSecond2:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui"):HasTag("LiveSaleSurfaceGui")) then
			if not t1[iterSecond2] then
				return
			end

			if iterSecond2 == u27 then
				return
			end

			u27 = iterSecond2
			updateHoverPosition()
			fullUpdateObject()
			playerGuiHoverInfoItem.Visible = u27 ~= nil

			return
		end
	end

	u27 = nil
	u34 = nil
	playerGuiHoverInfoItem.Visible = false
end

		task.spawn(function()
			local playerGuiHoverInfoAbsoluteSize = playerGuiHoverInfo.AbsoluteSize

			playerGuiHoverInfoItem.UIScale.Scale = math.max((playerGuiHoverInfoAbsoluteSize.X + playerGuiHoverInfoAbsoluteSize.Y) / 3000, 0.5)

function IsPartWithinPart(p16, p17)
	for _, v in ipairs(t1) do
		local n1 = p16.Position + p16.Size * v / 2
		local n2 = (n1 - (p17.Position + p17.Size * v / 2)).Unit * (p16.Position - n1).Unit

		if n2.X > 0 or n2.Z > 0 or n2.Y > 0 then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

local function addSwordToNPC(parent, p27, p28)
	local v150 = v20.getInstance("Swords", p27)

	if not v150 then
		return warn("Can't find sword", p27)
	end

	if v17:GetSword(p27) then
		local v151 = u67
		local ignoreAccessory = parent:GetAttribute("IgnoreAccessory")

		if not ignoreAccessory then
			ignoreAccessory = parent:GetAttribute("CurrentEmote") == "Emote711"
		end

		local equippedSword = v151:Add(assert(v17:EquipSwordTo(parent, p27, p28, ignoreAccessory)))

		equippedSword:SetAttribute("Sword", p27)
		equippedSword.Name = "EquippedSword"

		local v154 = nil

		for iterFirst, iterSecond in parent:GetChildren() do
			if iterSecond:GetAttribute("_swordAccessory") then
				v154 = iterSecond

				break
			end
		end

		if v154 then
			u67:Add(v16.observeChildren(v154, function(p29)
				if p29:HasTag("AnimatedAccessory") then
					p29:RemoveTag("AnimatedAccessory")

					local foundChild = p29:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
					local walk = foundChild and foundChild:FindFirstChild("Walk", true)

					if foundChild and walk then
						u67:Add(foundChild:LoadAnimation(walk)):Play()

						local v411 = v21[p27]

						if v411 and v411.walk then
							local id = v411.walk[1].id
							local v413 = u67:Add(Instance.new("Animation"))

							v413.AnimationId = id
							u67:Add(parent.Humanoid.Animator:LoadAnimation(v413)):Play()
						end
					end
				end

				return nil
			end))
		end

		return
	end

	local clone = u67:Clone(v150)

	clone.Name = "EquippedSword"
	clone:SetAttribute("Sword", p27)

	if p28 and p28 ~= 1 then
		local v158 = clone:GetScale()

		clone:ScaleTo(v158 * p28)
	end

	clone:PivotTo(parent:GetPivot())

	local Torso = parent.Torso

	for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in Torso.SwordWelds:GetChildren() do
		local foundChild = clone:FindFirstChild(iterSecond2.Name, true)

		iterSecond2.Part0 = Torso
		iterSecond2.Part1 = foundChild
		iterSecond2.Enabled = true
	end

	clone.Parent = parent
end

local function loadAnimation(p30, p31)
	return (u69:Add(p30.Humanoid.Animator:LoadAnimation(p31)))

local function updateRigSword(parent)
	local sword = parent:GetAttribute("Sword")
	local lastSword = parent:GetAttribute("LastSword")

	if sword ~= lastSword then
		parent:SetAttribute("LastSword", sword)
		u67:Clean()

		local v168 = nil

		if sword then
			v168 = sword

			local v169 = v19:GetInstance(sword)

			if v169 and not parent:GetAttribute("IgnoreAccessory") then
				local swordAccessories = u67:Add(Instance.new("Folder"))

				swordAccessories.Name = "SwordAccessories"
				swordAccessories:SetAttribute("_swordAccessory", true)

				local random = Random.new()

				swordAccessories:SetAttribute("Seed", random:NextNumber(0, 100))

				local clone = u67:Clone(v169)

				v15.Physics.ResizePart(clone, 1)

				for iterFirst, iterSecond in clone:GetChildren() do
					local foundChild = parent:FindFirstChild(iterSecond.Name)

					if foundChild and iterSecond:IsA("BasePart") then
						iterSecond:PivotTo(foundChild:GetPivot())
						iterSecond.CanCollide = false
						iterSecond.Anchored = false
						iterSecond.CanQuery = false
						iterSecond.CanTouch = false
						iterSecond.Massless = true
						iterSecond.Transparency = 1
						u67:Add(v15.Physics.CreateWeld(iterSecond, foundChild))
					end

					iterSecond.Parent = swordAccessories
				end

				u67:Remove(clone)
				swordAccessories.Parent = parent
			end
		end

		if v168 then
			addSwordToNPC(parent, v168, 1)
		end
	end

	local v176 = parent:GetAttribute("Slash") and sword and v17:GetSword(sword)

	if v176 then
		u69:Clean()
		print("play", v176.AnimationType or "SlashEffect")

		local serverParryCount = v43:GetAttribute("ServerParryCount")

		v43:SetAttribute("ServerParryCount", (serverParryCount or 0) + 1)

		local t10: {[any]: any} = { "Parry", "SuccessParry" }
		local v179 = v18:GetSuccessParryVariantCount(parent, v176.AnimationType, v176.SwordType)

		if v179 then
			t10[2] = ("SuccessParry%*"):format((v43:GetAttribute("ServerParryCount") or 0) % v179 + 1)
		end

		local v180 = v18:GetAnimations(parent, t10, v176.AnimationType, v176.SwordType)
		local v181 = table.create(#v180)

		for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in v180, nil, nil do
			local v184 = u69:Add(parent.Humanoid.Animator:LoadAnimation(iterSecond2))

			v184.Looped = false
			v181[iterFirst2] = v184
		end

		for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in v181, nil, nil do
			iterSecond3:Play(0)
		end

		local v187 = parent:FindFirstChild("SlashOrigin") or parent.Torso
		local parrySuccessClient = replicatedStorage2.Remotes.ParrySuccessClient
		local v189 = v18:GetSlashName(sword, v176.SlashName)

		parrySuccessClient:Fire(v189, v187, sword)
	end
end

local function formatStatus(p63)

		u439 = p63.serverType == "ProTradingPlaza"
	end

		local u440: boolean = true

			u440 = p63.maxPlayers <= 2
		end

		if u440 then
			return "IN DUEL", color32
		end

		return string.format("IN ROUND: %d:%02d", p63.roundSeconds // 60, p63.roundSeconds % 60), color32
	end

	return "LOBBY", color3
end

end

		return v21()
	end,
	Join = function(p68, p69, p70)
		if p69 == game.JobId then
			return
		end

		local v495 = t4[p69]

		if v495 then
			local foundChild = v495:FindFirstChild("Joining", true)

			if foundChild then
				foundChild.Visible = true
			end

			local foundChild2 = v495:FindFirstChild("Join", true)

			if foundChild2 then
				foundChild2.Visible = false
			end
		end

		if v31 then
			local v498 = ("[ServerBrowser] %*"):format((v25.describeJoin(p69, t1)))

			print(v498)
			task.wait(1)

			local joining = v495 and v495:FindFirstChild("Joining", true)

			if joining then
				joining.Visible = false
			end

			v12:Close("ServerBrowser", true)

			return
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return v11:Invoke("ServerBrowserTeleport", p69, p70)
		end)

		if ok and result == true then
			return
		end

		if v495 then
			local foundChild = v495:FindFirstChild("Joining", true)

			if foundChild then
				foundChild.Visible = false
			end
		end

		local u503: boolean = false

		for iterFirst, iterSecond in t2, nil, nil do
			if p69 == iterSecond.jobId then
				u503 = true
			elseif u503 and iterSecond.jobId ~= game.JobId then
				p68:Join(iterSecond.jobId, iterSecond.placeId)

				return
			end
		end
	end
}

local function bindJoin(p71, _)
	local parent = p71:FindFirstChild("Template") or p71
	local join = parent:FindFirstChild("Join")
	local v510 = not join and main.Left.LeftBg.ScrollingFrame.Selected.Template:FindFirstChild("Join")

	if v510 then
		join = v510:Clone()
		join.Parent = parent
	end

	if not join then
		return
	end

	local v511

	if join:IsA("GuiButton") then
		join.Active = true
		join.Selectable = true

		if not join:GetAttribute("SelectorSounds") then
			join:SetAttribute("SelectorSounds", true)
			bindSounds(join)
		end

		v511 = join
	else
		local foundChild = join:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton", true)

		if foundChild then
			foundChild.Active = true
			foundChild.Selectable = true

			if not foundChild:GetAttribute("SelectorSounds") then
				foundChild:SetAttribute("SelectorSounds", true)
				bindSounds(foundChild)
			end

			v511 = foundChild
		else
			v511 = nil
		end
	end

	if not v511 then
		return
	end

	v511.Activated:Connect(function()
		local v1014 = t5[p71]

		if not v1014 then
			return
		end

		local v1015 = ("Join %*, %*/%* players?"):format(v15.getDisplayName(v1014.country), v1014.players, v1014.maxPlayers)

		v22:CreatePrompt({
			PromptType = "Accept",
			AcceptButtonText = "Join",
			DeclineButtonText = "Cancel",
			Description = v1015
		}, function(p73)
			if p73 then
				module:Join(v1014.jobId, v1014.placeId)
			end
		end)
	end)
end
local function highlightOf(p74)
	local parent = p74:FindFirstChild("Template") or p74
	local selected = parent:FindFirstChild("Selected")

	if not selected then
		local selected2 = main.Left.LeftBg.ScrollingFrame.Selected.Template:FindFirstChild("Selected")

		if not selected2 then
			return nil
		end

		selected = selected2:Clone()
		selected.Parent = parent
	end

	if not selected:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		return nil
	end

	if not selected:GetAttribute("SelectorHighlight") then
		selected:SetAttribute("SelectorHighlight", true)
		selected.ImageTransparency = 1
		selected.Visible = true
	end

	return selected
end
local function bannerOf(p75)
	local parent = p75:FindFirstChild("Template") or p75
	local foundChild = parent:FindFirstChild("Best Match", true)

	if not foundChild then
		local foundChild3 = main.Left.LeftBg.ScrollingFrame.Selected.Template:FindFirstChild("Best Match")

		if not foundChild3 then
			return nil
		end

		foundChild = foundChild3:Clone()
		foundChild.Parent = parent

		local mode = parent:FindFirstChild("Mode")

		if mode and mode:IsA("GuiObject") and foundChild:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local uDim2FromScale = UDim2.fromScale
			local scale = mode.Position.X.Scale
			local v524 = math.max(0, mode.Position.Y.Scale - foundChild.Size.Y.Scale)

			foundChild.Position = uDim2FromScale(scale, v524)
		end
	end

	if foundChild:IsA("TextLabel") then
		return foundChild
	end

	return nil
end
local function paintRankBox(p76, p77)
	local rank = (p76:FindFirstChild("Template") or p76):FindFirstChild("Rank")
	local imageLabel = if rank then rank:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel") else nil

	if not imageLabel then
		return
	end

	local image: string = if p77 then "rbxassetid://107894640126789" else "rbxassetid://110487141601381"
	local rankBox = imageLabel:GetAttribute("RankBox")

	if image == rankBox then
		return
	end

	local rankBox2 = imageLabel:GetAttribute("RankBox")

	imageLabel:SetAttribute("RankBox", image)

	if rankBox2 == nil then
		imageLabel.Image = image

		return
	end

	local v532: Tween = tweenService:Create(imageLabel, tweenInfo6, { ImageTransparency = 1 })

	v532.Completed:Once(function()
		imageLabel.Image = imageLabel:GetAttribute("RankBox")
		tweenService:Create(imageLabel, tweenInfo6, { ImageTransparency = 0 }):Play()
	end)
	v532:Play()
end

				u59 = v1017.jobId
				n7 += 1

			return
		end
	end)
end
local function bindCardHover(p80)
	local template = p80:FindFirstChild("Template")

	if not template or not template:IsA("GuiObject") then
		return
	end

	local uiScale = template:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	local v538

	if uiScale then
		v538 = uiScale
	else
		local uiScale4: UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")

		uiScale4.Parent = template
		v538 = uiScale4
	end

	template.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		tweenService:Create(v538, tweenInfo4, { Scale = 1.02 }):Play()
	end)
	template.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		tweenService:Create(v538, tweenInfo4, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	end)
end

local function setBestMatchBadge(p87)
	local bestMatch = main.Right.BestMatch
	local shown = bestMatch:GetAttribute("Shown")

	if p87 == shown then
		return
	end

	bestMatch:SetAttribute("Shown", p87)

	local uiScale = bestMatch:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	local v636

	if uiScale then
		v636 = uiScale
	else
		local uiScale5: UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")

		uiScale5.Parent = bestMatch
		v636 = uiScale5
	end

	local n1: number = if p87 then 0 else 1
	local v639 = if p87 then tweenInfo7 else tweenInfo8

	if p87 then
		bestMatch.Visible = true
		v636.Scale = 0.7
	end

	local v640: Tween = tweenService:Create(v636, v639, {
		Scale = if p87 then 1 else 0.86
	})

	if not p87 then
		v640.Completed:Once(function()
			if bestMatch:GetAttribute("Shown") == false then
				bestMatch.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end

	v640:Play()

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in bestMatch:GetDescendants() do
		if iterSecond:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			tweenService:Create(iterSecond, v639, { ImageTransparency = n1 }):Play()
		elseif iterSecond:IsA("TextLabel") then
			tweenService:Create(iterSecond, v639, { TextTransparency = n1 }):Play()
		elseif iterSecond:IsA("UIStroke") then
			tweenService:Create(iterSecond, v639, { Transparency = n1 }):Play()
		end
	end
end

function module.Refresh(_)
	if u65 then
		return
	end

	u65 = true

	local v876 = v52()
	local v877: boolean = false

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in t14, nil, nil do
		if v876 == iterSecond.Label then
			local v880 = iterSecond

			v877 = true

			break
		end
	end

	if not v877 then
		v880 = t14[1]
	end

	local t38 = {}
	local t39 = {}
	local v883 = nil
	local u884: boolean = false
	local u885: boolean = false

	if v31 then
		local getServers = v25.getServers
		local serverType = v880.ServerType
		local placeKey = v880.PlaceKey
		local v889 = getCurrentSnapshot()

		t38 = getServers(serverType, placeKey, v889.country)
		u885 = true

		for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in t38, nil, nil do
			local v892 = v15.getContinent(iterSecond2.country)

			if v892 then
				t39[v892] = (t39[v892] or 0) + 1
			end
		end

		local v893 = v880.ServerType
		local v894 = v18()

		if v893 == v894 then
			local v895 = makeSimulatedSelf(v880.ServerType, t38[1])

			table.insert(t38, v895)
		end
	else
		local v896, v897, v898 = pcall(function()
			return v11:Invoke("RefreshServerBrowser", nil, v880.ServerType)
		end)

		if v896 and v898 == "loading" then
			u66 = v876
			u65 = false
			paintLiveStatus()
			task.delay(2, function()
				if v52() == v876 then
					module:Refresh()
				end
			end)

			return
		end

		if v896 and type(v897) == "table" then
			u885 = true

			for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in v897, nil, nil do
				if typeof(iterSecond3) == "buffer" then
					local v901 = v15.readReplicationBuffer(iterSecond3)

					if v901 then
						table.insert(t38, v901)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local n1 = 0
		local n2: number = 0

		for iterFirst4, iterSecond4 in t38, nil, nil do
			n1 = math.max(n1, iterSecond4.placeVersion)
		end

		for iterFirst5, iterSecond5 in t38, nil, nil do
			if n1 <= iterSecond5.placeVersion then
				n2 += 1
			end
		end

		v883 = if n1 > 0 then n1 else nil
		u884 = #t38 > 0 and n2 / #t38 >= 0.4

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return v11:Invoke("ServerBrowserCounts", v880.ServerType)
		end)

		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			t39 = result
		end
	end

	u65 = false

	if v876 == u66 then
		u66 = nil
	end

	paintLiveStatus()

	local v910 = t10[v876] or emptyFleet()

	if u885 then
		v910.servers = t38
		v910.counts = t39
		v910.latestPlaceVersion = v883
		v910.oldBuildsExcluded = u884
	end

	v910.updatedAt = os.time()
	t10[v876] = v910

	local v911 = v52()

	if v876 ~= v911 then
		return
	end

	applyFleet(v910)
	n8 = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000
	n7 += 1
	v54(n7)
end

function getServerData(p13)
	for _, v in ipairs(u63) do
		if p13 == v.key then
			return v
		end

function individualSearchQuery(p14)
	local serverData = getServerData(p14)

	if not serverData then
		return false
	end

	if #serverData.value.InServer == 0 or #serverData.value.UserNames == 0 then
		return false
	end

	local stringFind = string.find
	local lowerText = serverData.value.Region:lower()

	if stringFind(lowerText, s6) then
		return true
	end

	if serverData.value.UserNames then
		for _, v in ipairs(serverData.value.UserNames) do
			local v89 = string.find
			local lowerText2 = v:lower()

			if v89(lowerText2, s6) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	local v91 = string.find
	local lowerText3 = (serverData.value.RoomName or serverData.key):lower()

	if v91(lowerText3, s6) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end
function renderPlayerIcon(p15, p16)
	local v95, v96 = v22:Get(p15)

	if not v95 then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(p15, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
		end)

		v95 = ok
		v96 = result
	end

	if v95 then
		v22:Append(p15, v96)
		p16.Image = v96

		return
	end

	p16.Image = ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%d&w=60&h=60"):format(p15)
end
function renderClientCache()
	if u57 then
		return
	end

	if not u63 then
		return
	end

	u57 = true

	local RegionValue = replicatedStorage3.ServerInfo.Region.Value
	local t7: {[any]: any} = {}

	for _, v in ipairs(u63) do
		local vKey = v.key
		local vValue = v.value
		local v105 = vValue.MaxPlayers or players.MaxPlayers

		t7[vKey] = true

		local v106 = t2[vKey]

		if v106 == nil then
			task.wait(0.1)

			local clone = serverSelection.Assets.ServerTemplate:Clone()

			clone.PlayerCount.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				if u60 == vKey then
					u60 = nil
					InServer = nil
					v58:Fire(false)
				end
			end)

			local connection = clone.PlayerCount.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				if u60 == vKey then
					u60 = nil
					InServer = nil
					v58:Fire(false)

					return
				end

				local value = nil

				for _, _ in ipairs(u63) do
					if v.key == vKey then
						value = v.value

						break
					end
				end

				if value then
					u60 = vKey
					InServer = value.InServer
					v58:Fire(true)
				end
			end)

			local connection2 = clone.JoinButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				clone.JoinButton.Active = false
				task.delay(2, function()
					clone.JoinButton.Active = true
				end)

				local v246, v247 = v43:InvokeServer(vKey)

				if v246 then
					v12:Close("ServerSelection", true)
				end
			end)

			clone.Destroying:Once(function()
				connection2:Disconnect()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)
			clone.Parent = serverSelection.ServerBrowser.Servers
			t2[vKey] = clone
			v106 = clone
		end

		v106.RoomName.Text = vValue.RoomName or vKey
		v106.PlayerCount.PlayerCountValue.Text = ("%d/%d"):format(#vValue.InServer, v105)

		if vValue.Region == "None" then
			v106.Ping.Text = ("%s\n%d ms"):format("Unknown Region", vValue.Ping)
		else
			v106.Ping.Text = ("%s\n%d ms"):format(vValue.Region, vValue.Ping)
		end

		if v105 <= #vValue.InServer then
			v106.Status.Text = "FULL"
			v106.JoinButton.Visible = false
		elseif vKey == game.JobId then
			v106.Status.Text = "YOUR SERVER"
			v106.JoinButton.Visible = false
		else
			v106.Status.Text = if v105 > 1 then "MULTIPLAYER" else "SINGLEPLAYER"
			v106.JoinButton.Visible = v105 > 1 and not runService:IsStudio()
		end

		if RegionValue == vValue.Region then
			v106.LayoutOrder = vValue.Ping
		else
			v106.LayoutOrder = 100000 + vValue.Ping
		end
	end

	for k, v in pairs(t2) do
		if not t7[k] then
			t2[k] = nil
			v:Destroy()
		elseif s6 then
			v.Visible = individualSearchQuery(v43)
		else
			v.Visible = true
		end
	end

	u57 = false
end

function updateTradePlazaAccessibility(p18)
	local v115 = v28:GetPolicyInfo()
	local tradePlaza = serverSelection.Options:FindFirstChild("TradePlaza")

	if p18 then
		tradePlaza = serverSelection.Options.Play:FindFirstChild("TradePlaza")
	end

	if not tradePlaza then
		return
	end

	local v117 = u34:Get("TradeLockedUntil")
	local v118: number = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local title = tradePlaza.LockedOverlay.Title

	if not v115.IsPaidItemTradingAllowed then
		title.Text = "Not available in your region"
	elseif not u34:Get("TradeBanned") and (not v117 or not (v117 > 0) or not (v117 > v118)) then
		title.Text = "1+ Wins Required"
	else
		title.Text = "Not available"
	end

	title.Parent.Visible = not v13.TradingPlaza.Accessible(LocalPlayer) and not t1.TradePlaza or not v115.IsPaidItemTradingAllowed
end
function updateRankedAccessibility(p19)
	local ranked = serverSelection.Options:FindFirstChild("Ranked")

	if p19 then
		ranked = serverSelection.Options.Competitive.List:FindFirstChild("Ranked")
	end

	local v122, v123 = v13.Ranked.Accessible(LocalPlayer)

	if v122 and not t1.Ranked then
		ranked.LockedOverlay.Visible = false

		return
	end

	ranked.LockedOverlay.Visible = true

	if t1.Ranked then
		ranked.LockedOverlay.Title.Text = "This Mode Is Disabled"

		return
	end

	if v123 == -1 then
		ranked.LockedOverlay.Title.Text = "You're Banned"

		return
	end

	ranked.LockedOverlay.Title.Text = ("%*+ Wins Required"):format(v123)
end

			local default = v280.Default

			iterSecond:Update(v281, iterFirst)

			if iterFirst == "Music" then
				soundService.Music.Volume = 0.5 * v281 / default
			elseif iterFirst == "SFX" then
				soundService.SFX.Volume = 0.5 * v281 / default

			end
		end
	end

function module.UpdateAllMisc()

			v310:Update(v311, iterFirst)
			u309 = true

function module.ResetSettingsToDefault()
	for iterFirst, iterSecond in v16.Volume, nil, nil do
		if typeof(iterSecond) == "table" then
			u34:FireServer(iterFirst, iterSecond.Default)
		end
	end

	for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in v16.Keybinds, nil, nil do
		if typeof(iterSecond2) == "table" then
			u35:FireServer("PC", "Reset", iterFirst2, iterSecond2.Default.PC)
			u35:FireServer("Console", "Reset", iterFirst2, iterSecond2.Default.Console)
		end
	end

	for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in v16.Accessibility, nil, nil do
		if typeof(iterSecond3) == "table" and iterSecond3.Type == "Color" then
			u38:FireServer("Accessibility", iterFirst3, nil)
		end
	end

	for iterFirst4, iterSecond4 in v16.Misc, nil, nil do
		if typeof(iterSecond4) == "table" and iterSecond4.Validate and not iterSecond4.ResetIgnore then
			local v323 = string.match(iterFirst4, "^(.+)ButtonPosition$")
			local v324 = string.match(iterFirst4, "^(.+)ButtonScale$")

			if v323 then
				u40:FireServer(v323, iterSecond4.Default)
			elseif v324 then
				u41:FireServer(v324, iterSecond4.Default)
			elseif iterFirst4 == "Time Of Day" then
				u39:FireServer("Misc", iterFirst4, iterSecond4.Default)
				u36:FireServer(iterFirst4, iterSecond4.Enabled == true)
			elseif iterSecond4.Max == nil then
				u36:FireServer(iterFirst4, iterSecond4.Enabled == true)
			else
				u34:FireServer(iterFirst4, iterSecond4.Default)
			end
		end
	end
end
function module.UseBind(_, input, p76)
	if not u32 then
		return
	end

	debug.profilebegin("SettingsController:Usebind")

	local settings = u32.Data.Settings
	local v329 = module:GetBinds(p76)
	local v330 = module:GetDefault(p76)
	local v331 = v329.Bind1 ~= "" and v329.Bind1 or v330
	local u332: boolean = false
	local userInputType = input.UserInputType
	local keyCode = input.KeyCode
	local v335 = module:GetBinds("Block")

	if v331 == keyCode.Name or keyCode.Name == v329.Bind2 or keyCode.Name == v329.Bind3 or v331 == userInputType.Name or userInputType.Name == v329.Bind2 or userInputType.Name == v329.Bind3 or v7.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter and userInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and v335.Bind1 ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2.Name and v335.Bind2 ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2.Name and v335.Bind3 ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2.Name and p76 == "Ability" then
		u332 = true
	end

	debug.profileend()

	return u332
end

			v107 = pivot:ToObjectSpace(iterSecond2:GetPivot())
			t1[iterSecond2] = v107
		end

		if not t2[iterSecond2] then
			t2[iterSecond2] = iterSecond2:GetScale()
		end

		if not holoPadLayoutVisiblePads or iterSecond2:GetAttribute("IsShown") == true then
			local v108 = v97:ToObjectSpace(pivot * v107)

			table.insert(t10, { Pad = iterSecond2, Local = v108 })
		end
	end

	table.sort(t10, function(p20, p21)
		return p20.Local.Position.X < p21.Local.Position.X
	end)

	if holoPadLayout then
		if holoPadLayout.SwapSides and #t10 == 2 then
			local v109 = t10[1].Local
			local v110 = t10[2].Local
			local v111 = t10[1]
			local n1 = v109 - v109.Position
			local vector3 = Vector3.new(v110.Position.X, v109.Position.Y, v109.Position.Z)

			n1 = v110 - v110.Position

			v111.Local = n1 + vector32
		end

		if holoPadLayout.AlignDepth then
			local n2 = math.huge

			for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in t10, nil, nil do
				n2 = math.min(n2, iterSecond3.Local.Position.Z)
			end

			end
		end

		if holoPadLayout.AlignHeight then

			for iterFirst5, iterSecond5 in t10, nil, nil do
				n4 += iterSecond5.Local.Position.Y
			end

			local v126 = math.max(#t10, 1)

			end
		end

		local v133 = holoPadLayout.HeightOffset or 0
		local v134 = holoPadLayout.DepthOffset or 0

		if #t10 == 1 then

			if v137 and single ~= v135.Pad then
				local v138 = v135.Local.Position
				local v139 = v97:ToObjectSpace(pivot * v137)

				v135.Local = n6 + vector3
			end
		end

		for iterFirst7, iterSecond7 in t10, nil, nil do

		end
	end

	local v146 = holoPadLayout and holoPadLayout.PadScale or 1

	for iterFirst8, iterSecond8 in t10, nil, nil do
		local pad = iterSecond8.Pad
		local n7 = (holoPadLayout and holoPadLayout.PadBaseScale or t2[pad] or 1) * v146
		local v151 = pad:GetScale()

		if math.abs(v151 - n7) > 0.0001 then
			pad:ScaleTo(n7)
		end

		pad:PivotTo(v97 * iterSecond8.Local)
	end
end

		end

		local function sendText(p61)
			local v250 = v47:Get()

			if not v250 then
				p61.Text = "Text Channel not found! Please report to the devs!"

				return
			end

			local text = p61.Text
			local s1 = ""

			p61.TextEditable = false

			local u253 = nil

			u253 = task.delay(v13.Chat.Cooldown, function()
				p61.TextEditable = true
				u253 = nil
			end)

			local function cancelCooldown()
				p61.Text = s1

				if u253 then
					p61.TextEditable = true
					v15.Thread.SafeCancel(u253)
					u253 = nil
				end
			end

			if #text > v13.Chat.MaxMessageLength then
				p61.Text = ("Text too long (%*/%*)"):format(p61.Text, v13.Chat.MaxMessageLength)
				task.delay(0.5, cancelCooldown)

				return
			end

			if not (#text < v13.Chat.MinMessageLength) then
				local v255 = os.clock()

				if v255 - n1 < v13.Chat.Cooldown then
					p61.Text = "Please wait before sending another message"
					s1 = text
					task.delay(0.5, cancelCooldown)

					return
				end

				p61.Text = ""
				n1 = v255

				local ok, result = pcall(v250.SendAsync, v250, text)

				if not ok then
					local taskSpawn = task.spawn
					local v259 = ("[TradeChat] - Failed to send message %*"):format(result)

					taskSpawn(error, v259)
				end

				p61.Text = s1

				if u253 then
					p61.TextEditable = true
					v15.Thread.SafeCancel(u253)
					u253 = nil
				end

				return
			end

			if text == "" then
				return
			end

			p61.Text = ("Text too small (%*/%*)"):format(p61.Text, v13.Chat.MinMessageLength)
			task.delay(0.5, cancelCooldown)
		end

function isPremium()
	return LocalPlayer.MembershipType == Enum.MembershipType.Premium
end
function updateMembershipUI()
	if isPremium() then
		coinsEarned.PerMinute.Amount.Text = "+2"
		starsEarned.PerMinute.Amount.Text = "+4"
	else
		coinsEarned.PerMinute.Amount.Text = "+1"
		starsEarned.PerMinute.Amount.Text = "+2"
	end

	premiumRewards.Buy.Visible = not isPremium()
	premiumRewards.PremiumSupporter.Visible = isPremium()
end

function module.CanPlayRewardSound(p30)

	if v303 - p30._lastRewardSoundTime < p30._rewardSoundCooldown then
		return false
	end

	p30._lastRewardSoundTime = v303

	return true
end

		return false

	p31._lastRewardGlowSoundTime = v305

end
function module.DoItemGlow(_, p33, _)
	local clone = p33:Clone()

	clone.Parent = p33.Parent
	clone.ZIndex = -10

	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local v311 = UDim2.fromScale(1.5, 1.5)
	local v312: Tween = tweenService:Create(clone, tweenInfo, { Size = v311 })
	local tweenInfo2 = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, 0.1)
	local v314: Tween = tweenService:Create(clone, tweenInfo2, { ImageTransparency = 1 })

	v312:Play()
	v314:Play()

	if module:CanPlayRewardGlowSound() then
		local sound: Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://6895079853"
		sound.Parent = soundService
		sound.Volume = 0.2
		sound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.5
		sound.TimePosition = 0
		sound:Play()
		sound.Ended:Once(function()
			sound:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	v314.Completed:Connect(function()
		clone:Destroy()
	end)
end
function module.DoSpinAnimation(p35, p36, p37)
	local numberValue: NumberValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	local value = p36 + 80
	local u321 = nil
	local n2 = 0
	local u323: boolean = false

	local function endAnimation()
		local clone = nil

		if p35:CanPlayRewardSound() then
			clone = replicatedStorage2.Misc.reward:Clone()
			clone.Volume = 0.34
			clone.Parent = script
			clone:Play()
		end

		p37()

		for k, v in pairs(t4) do
			v.Glow.Visible = k == p36

			if k == p36 then
				module:DoItemGlow(v.Glow, p36)
			end
		end

		if clone then
			clone.Ended:Once(function()
				clone:Destroy()
				numberValue:Destroy()
			end)
		else
			numberValue:Destroy()
		end
	end

	if p35._skipping then
		return endAnimation()
	end

	numberValue.Changed:Connect(function()
		local n1: number = numberValue.Value - 1
		local n3 = math.floor(n1) % 8 + 1

		if numberValue.Value >= value - 1 and numberValue.Value < value then
			u323 = math.random() < 0.5
		end

		if u321 then
			u321.Visible = false
		end

		u321 = t3[n3]

		if u321 then
			u321.Position = UDim2.fromScale(n1 % 1, 0.5)
		end

		if n3 ~= n2 then
			for k, v in pairs(t4) do
				v.Glow.Visible = k == n3
			end

			local clone = replicatedStorage2.Misc.bink:Clone()

			clone.Parent = script
			clone.Volume = clone.Volume or 0.34
			clone:Play()
			task.delay(clone.TimeLength + 0.1, function()
				clone:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		n2 = n3
	end)

	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(if p35._skipping then 3 else 5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, 0)
	local v326: Tween = tweenService:Create(numberValue, tweenInfo, { Value = value })

	v326:Play()
	v326.Completed:Connect(function()
		if u321 then
			if u323 then
				local v523 = u321
				local v524 = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.5)

				v523:TweenPosition(v524, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, 1, true)
				task.wait(1)
				v523 = u321
				v524 = UDim2.fromScale(-0.5, 0.5)
				v523:TweenPosition(v524, Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, 1, true)
			else
				local v525 = u321
				local v526 = UDim2.fromScale(-0.5, 0.5)

				v525:TweenPosition(v526, Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, 1, true)
			end

			task.wait(1)
			u321.Visible = false
		end

		endAnimation()
	end)
end

		spin.Desc1.Visible = v441
		spin.Desc2.Visible = true
		spin.ImageColor3 = v441 <= 0 and n1 <= 0 and Color3.fromRGB(75, 75, 75) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	else
		spin.ImageColor3 = v441 <= 0 and n1 <= 0 and Color3.fromRGB(75, 75, 75) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end

	if v437 and u442 and n1 <= 0 then
		spin.Title.Currency.Visible = true
		spin.Title.Text = v436.EventCurrencySpinPrice
		spin.Desc1.Text = "Spin"
		spin.Desc1.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.175)
		spin.Title.Currency.Image = v34.SeasonData.Currency.Icon

		return
	end

	spin.Title.Currency.Visible = false
	spin.Desc1.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.15)
end
function module.CheckForSpinLastSpin(p49)
	local currentGachaIdentifier = getCurrentGachaIdentifier(p49.DataReplion)
	local currentGachaData = getCurrentGachaData(p49.DataReplion)
	local v454 = p49.DataReplion:GetExpect({ "GachaData", currentGachaIdentifier, "TotalSpins" })

	if currentGachaData.CrateSpinRequirement - (v454 - (v454 - v454 % currentGachaData.CrateSpinRequirement)) <= 10 then
		local v455 = p49.DataReplion:GetExpect({ "GachaData", currentGachaIdentifier, "LastSpunTimeStamp" })

		if v455 then
			if os.time() - v455 >= 90000 then
				p49._urgentLastSpins = true

				return
			end

			p49._urgentLastSpins = false

			return
		end
	else
		p49._urgentLastSpins = false
	end
end

	local function updateQueue()
		if u48 then
			return
		end

		local v565 = t1[1]

		if not v565 then
			return
		end

		local v566, v567 = table.unpack(v565)

		u48 = true
		u49 = v566

		if not v21:IsOpen(u43.Name) and players.LocalPlayer.Character and players.LocalPlayer.Character:IsDescendantOf(workspace.Dead) then
			v21:Open(u43.Name)
		end

		local currentGachaData = getCurrentGachaData(p52.DataReplion)
		local n3: number = #v567
		local disableWheelSpin = p52.DataReplion.Data.GachaData.DisableWheelSpin

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			if disableWheelSpin then
				u44.Visible = false
				u489.Visible = true

				if spinShop then
					spinShop.Visible = false
				end

				p52:UpdateGachaOdds()
			end

			for iterFirst, iterSecond in v567, nil, nil do
				local v660 = currentGachaData.FrameAlliases[iterSecond.RewardKey]

				if not v660 then
					v660 = math.random(2, 8)
				end

				if v660 then
					if disableWheelSpin then
						p52:AddRewardToBulkGrid(iterSecond)

						if iterFirst % 25 == 0 then
							task.wait()
						end
					else
						p52:UpdateGachaOdds()

						local v661 = coroutine.running()

						module:DoSpinAnimation(v660, function()
							u43.SpinShop.Visible = false
							module:ShowRewardScreen(iterSecond)
							task.defer(function()
								v17.Thread.SafeResume(v661)
							end)
						end)
						coroutine.yield()
					end

					iterSecond.Done = true
					n1 -= 1
					n2 -= 1

					if not disableWheelSpin or iterFirst == n3 then
						p52:UpdateFTPSpins()
						p52:UpdateLeftSide()
						p52:UpdatePittyFrame()

						if u67 then
							u67()
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		if not ok then
			for iterFirst, iterSecond in v567, nil, nil do
				iterSecond.Done = true
			end

			p52:UpdateFTPSpins()
			p52:UpdateLeftSide()
			p52:UpdatePittyFrame()
		end

		local v575 = u49
		local currentGachaIdentifier = getCurrentGachaIdentifier(p52.DataReplion)

		if v575 ~= currentGachaIdentifier then
			task.wait(3)
		end

		table.remove(t1, 1)
		u48 = false
		u49 = nil

		if u67 then
			u67()
		end

		task.spawn(updateQueue)
	end

	return p2.FFlagStartTime and v17:GetKey(p2.FFlagStartTime) or p2.RootFFlagStartTime and v17:GetKey(p2.RootFFlagStartTime) or 0
end
local function getEndDate(p3)
	return p3.FFlagEndTime and v17:GetKey(p3.FFlagEndTime) or p3.RootFFlagEndTime and v17:GetKey(p3.RootFFlagEndTime) or 0
end
local function getProductRank(p4)
	return p4 and t2[p4] or nil
end
local function getBundleRank(p5)
	local v56 = nil

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in p5.Rewards or {}, nil, nil do
		local productId = iterSecond.ProductId
		local v60 = productId and t2[productId] or nil

		if v60 and (not v56 or v56 > v60) then
			v56 = v60
		end
	end

	return v56
end
local function getRankedRewards(p6)
	local v62 = table.clone(p6)
	local t4: {[any]: any} = {}

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in p6, nil, nil do
		t4[iterSecond] = iterFirst
	end

	table.sort(v62, function(p7, p8)
		local productId = p7.ProductId
		local v298 = productId and t2[productId] or nil
		local v299 = p8.ProductId
		local v300 = v299 and t2[v299] or nil

		if v298 ~= v300 then
			if not v298 then
				return false
			end

			if not v300 then
				return true
			end

			return v298 < v300
		end

		return t4[p7] < t4[p8]
	end)

	return v62
end
local function getTopRankedBundle(p9)
	local v67 = nil
	local v68 = nil
	local v69 = nil
	local n1 = math.huge

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in p9, nil, nil do
		for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in iterSecond.Rewards, nil, nil do
			local v75 = getBundleRank(iterSecond2)
			local n2 = (iterFirst - 1) * 100 + iterFirst2

			if not v67 or v75 and not v69 or v75 and v69 and v69 > v75 or v75 == v69 and n1 > n2 then
				v67 = iterSecond2
				v68 = ("%*_%*"):format(iterFirst, iterSecond2.Name)
				v69 = v75
				n1 = n2
			end
		end
	end

	return v67, v68
end

local function previewReward(p33, p34)
	local v203 = p34 and p34.Type
	local u204 = true

	if v203 ~= "Emote" then
		u204 = true

		if v203 ~= "Sword" then
			u204 = true

			if v203 ~= "SwordAccessory" then
				u204 = v203 == "Explosion"
			end
		end
	end

	if not u204 then
		return
	end

	local v205 = v23:Get("SwordPacks")
	local selected = v205.Info.Selected

	v203 = if not v205 then nil else if not selected then nil else v205.Instance.InnerShowRooms:FindFirstChild(selected)
	u204 = if not v203 then nil else v203.NPCS:FindFirstChild("1")

	if not u204 then
		return
	end

	if p34.Type == "Explosion" then
		local v207 = os.clock()

		if v207 - (t4[p33] or 0) < 1 then
			return
		end

		t4[p33] = v207
		playExplosionPreview(p33, u204, p34.Value)

		return
	end

	if p34.Type == "Sword" or p34.Type == "SwordAccessory" then
		local v208 = t7[p33]
		local v209 = if not (if p34 and typeof(p34.Value) == "string" then if p34.Type == "Sword" or p34.Type == "SwordAccessory" then if v19:GetCollection()[p34.Value] then p34.Value else nil else nil else nil) then nil else if v208 == nil then true else v208

		u204:SetAttribute("IsShown", false)
		u204:SetAttribute("ForceIdle", nil)
		u204:SetAttribute("IgnoreAccessory", if v209 == nil then nil else not v209)
		u204:SetAttribute("Sword", p34.Value)
		u204:SetAttribute("Emote", nil)

		if p34.Type == "SwordAccessory" then
			u204:SetAttribute("Slash", nil)
			u204:SetAttribute("NoEmote", true)
		else
			u204:SetAttribute("NoEmote", nil)
			u204:SetAttribute("Slash", true)
		end

		u204:SetAttribute("IsShown", true)
		u49 = p33
		refreshPreviewSelection()

		return
	end

	u204:SetAttribute("IsShown", false)
	u204:SetAttribute("ForceIdle", nil)
	v203 = v17:GetInstance(p34.Value)

	if v203 and v203:GetAttribute("HideSword") then
		u204:SetAttribute("Sword", nil)
	else
		local v210 = v18:GetInstance(p34.Value)
		local v211 = v210 and v210:GetAttribute("Sword")

		if v211 then
			u204:SetAttribute("Sword", v211)
		else
			local v212 = getBundlePackSword(module.CurrentBundle)

			if v212 then
				u204:SetAttribute("Sword", v212)
			end
		end
	end

	u204:SetAttribute("IgnoreAccessory", if p34.Value == "Emote711" then false else nil)
	u204:SetAttribute("NoEmote", nil)
	u204:SetAttribute("Slash", nil)
	u204:SetAttribute("Emote", nil)
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait()

		if not u204.Parent then
			return
		end

		u204:SetAttribute("Emote", p34.Value)
		u204:SetAttribute("IsShown", true)
		u49 = p33
		refreshPreviewSelection()
	end)
end

local function ensurePreviewSlots(parent, p39, p40)
	local t29: {[any]: any} = {}

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in parent:GetChildren() do
		if iterSecond.Name == "Slot" then
			table.insert(t29, iterSecond)
		end
	end

	table.sort(t29, function(p41, p42)
		return p41.LayoutOrder < p42.LayoutOrder
	end)

	while p39 > #t29 do
		local clone = p40:Clone()

		clone.Name = "Slot"
		clone.Parent = parent
		table.insert(t29, clone)
	end

	while true do
		local v269 = math.max(p39, 2)

		if not (#t29 > v269) then
			break
		end

		local v270 = table.remove(t29)

		if v270 then
			v270:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in t29, nil, nil do
		iterSecond2.LayoutOrder = iterFirst2
	end

	local uiListLayout = parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIListLayout")
	local n1: number = if p39 > 2 then 2 else 1
	local v275 = t6[parent]

	if not v275 then
		v275 = parent.Size.X.Scale
		t6[parent] = v275
	end

	local parentSize = parent.Size

	parent.Size = UDim2.new(v275 * (if n1 > 1 then 1.5 else 1), parentSize.X.Offset, parentSize.Y.Scale, parentSize.Y.Offset)

	if uiListLayout then
		uiListLayout.FillDirection = if n1 > 1 then Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal else Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
		uiListLayout.Wraps = n1 > 1
		uiListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		uiListLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
		uiListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(if n1 > 1 then 0.02 else 0.07, 0)
	end

	if u42 and p39 > 0 then
		local roundedUp = math.ceil(p39 / n1)
		local n2: number = if n1 > 1 then 0.02 else 0.07
		local v279 = math.min(u42.X.Scale / (if n1 > 1 then 1.5 else 1), (1 - n2 * n1) / n1)
		local v280 = math.min(u42.Y.Scale, (1 - n2 * roundedUp) / roundedUp)

		for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in t29, nil, nil do
			iterSecond3.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v279, v280)
		end
	end

	return t29
end

		end

		v336 = if p55.Stock then { p55.Stock } else {}

			end

local function buildBundleEntries()
	local t33: {[any]: any} = {}
	local t34: {[any]: any} = {}
	local t35: {[any]: any} = {}
	local n1: number = 0
	local innerShowRooms = replicatedStorage2.Misc.ShowRooms.SwordPacks.InnerShowRooms

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in v26:GetActiveBundles() do
		local v389 = iterSecond.RootFFlagStartTime or ("pack%*"):format(iterFirst)

		if not t34[v389] then
			n1 += 1
			t34[v389] = n1
			t35[v389] = 0
		end

		for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in iterSecond.Rewards, nil, nil do
			if innerShowRooms:FindFirstChild(iterSecond2.ShowRoom) then
				local v392 = getStockKeys(iterSecond2)
				local v393, v394 = readStock(v392)
				local u395: boolean = #v392 > 0 and v394 > 0

				if not u395 or not (v393 <= 0) then
					t35[v389] = t35[v389] + 1

					local s1: string = iterFirst .. "_" .. iterSecond2.Name
					local v397 = t34[v389]
					local v398 = t35[v389]
					local v399 = isEmoteOnlyBundle(iterSecond2)

					table.insert(t33, {
						Bundle = iterSecond2,
						Pack = iterSecond,
						Key = s1,
						Group = v397,
						Position = v398,
						Limited = u395,
						EmoteOnly = v399,
						FullPack = if (iterSecond2.TemplateType or iterSecond2.Type) == "Sword" then false else true,
						InitialStock = v394,
						Name = iterSecond2.Name or ""
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.sort(t33, function(p69, p70)
		if p69.Limited ~= p70.Limited then
			return p69.Limited
		end

		if p69.Limited then
			if p69.EmoteOnly ~= p70.EmoteOnly then
				return p70.EmoteOnly
			end

			if p69.InitialStock ~= p70.InitialStock then
				return p69.InitialStock < p70.InitialStock
			end

			return p69.Name < p70.Name
		end

		if p69.Group ~= p70.Group then
			return p69.Group < p70.Group
		end

		if p69.FullPack ~= p70.FullPack then

	_renderLeaderboard = function(p41, p42, p43)
		if p41._drawingFrames then
			return
		end

		p41._drawingFrames = true

		local v253 = os.clock()
		local parent = t8[p41._leaderboardFilter .. p42] or t8.Main

		p41:_toggleLeaderboardFrame(parent)

		if not p43 and v253 < object[parent] then
			p41._drawingFrames = false

			return
		end

		scriptHoverInfo.Parent = script
		p41:_clearLeaderboard("Main")
		object[parent] = 9000000000

		local n1: number = 0

		scriptHoverInfo.Parent = nil

		for iterFirst, iterSecond in p41._playerList[u97][p42], nil, nil do
			if n1 == 100 then
				break
			end

			if p42 == p41._leaderboardMode and v19.MatchToRegion(iterSecond, p41._leaderboardFilter) then
				if u97 ~= u97 then
					break
				end

				n1 += 1

				local foundChild = parent:FindFirstChild(iterSecond.UserId)

				if foundChild then
					foundChild:Destroy()
				end

				local v259 = v19.CreateLabelFrom(iterSecond, n1, scriptPlayerTemplate, scriptHoverInfo)

				v259.Parent = parent
			end
		end

		rankedSelectionPageWindowsLeaderboard.Loading.Visible = false

		for _ = 1, 3 do
			local clone = scriptPlayerTemplate:Clone()

			clone:ClearAllChildren()
			clone.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			clone.Parent = parent
			clone.LayoutOrder = 501
		end

		object[parent] = 0
		p41._drawingFrames = false
	end,

				end
			end

			for k, v in pairs(p75) do
				local k = rankedSelectionPageWindowsStatisticsAbilityStats:FindFirstChild(k)

				if k then
					updateAbility(k, v)
				end
			end

			for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in rankedSelectionPageWindowsStatisticsAbilityStats:GetChildren() do
				if iterSecond2:IsA("GuiObject") and not p75[iterSecond2.Name] then
					local timeCounter = iterSecond2:FindFirstChild("TimeCounter")
					local barFrame = iterSecond2:FindFirstChild("BarFrame")

						iterSecond2.TimeCounter.Text = tostring(0) .. " Rounds"
					end

					iterSecond2.LayoutOrder = 9000000

					if barFrame then
						barFrame.Progress.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0 / n1, 1)
					end
				end
			end

			return
		end
	end,

				purchaseButton.Visible = false
			else
				favorite.Visible = false

				if itemInfo.Price then
					purchaseButton.Visible = true
					purchaseButton.Label.Text = ("Purchase for %* Coins"):format(itemInfo.Price)
				elseif itemInfo.Attributes.Pack then
					purchaseButton.Visible = true
					purchaseButton.Label.Text = itemInfo.Attributes.Pack
				else
					purchaseButton.Visible = false
				end

				upgrades.Visible = false
				arrowButton.Visible = false
				upgradeButton.Visible = false
				equipButton.Visible = false
			end

			local v360 = client:KeyToItem(v357.ParsedItemKey).Upgrade or 0
			local n1: number = 0

			for i = 1, 3 do
				local v363 = ("Description%*"):format(i)
				local foundChild = upgradesInfo:FindFirstChild(v363)

				if foundChild then
					local v365 = itemInfo.Upgrade.UpgradeInfo[i]

					if v365 then
						foundChild.UpgradeDesc.Text = v365
						foundChild.OwnedLabel.Visible = v360 >= i
						foundChild.Visible = i <= itemInfo.Upgrade.MaxUpgrade
						n1 += 1
					else
						foundChild.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end

			for i = 1, 3 do
				local v367 = ("Description%*"):format(i)
				local foundChild2 = upgradesInfo:FindFirstChild(v367)

				if foundChild2 then
					foundChild2.Size = if n1 == 3 then UDim2.fromScale(0.832, 0.28) else UDim2.fromScale(0.832, 0.44)

					if i == 1 then
						foundChild2.Position = if n1 == 3 then UDim2.fromScale(0.122, 0.05) else UDim2.fromScale(0.122, 0.035)
					elseif i == 2 then
						foundChild2.Position = if n1 == 3 then UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.35) else UDim2.fromScale(0.07, 0.51)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			upgradesInfo.Visible = false
		end

		if u157 and v357 ~= u157 then
			upgradesInfo.Visible = false
		end

		u157 = v357

		return nil
	end)

	local v158 = v10.new()

	v16.Computed(function(p29)
		v158:Destroy()
		killsProgressBar.Visible = false

		local v370 = p29(t5.Ability)

		if v370 then
			local itemInfo = v370.ItemInfo
			local v372 = client:KeyToItem(v370.ParsedItemKey).Upgrade or 0
			local maxUpgrade = itemInfo.Upgrade.MaxUpgrade

			if v372 == maxUpgrade then
				upgradeButton.MidUpgrade.Text = "Max"
				upgradeButton.ImageLabel.Visible = false
				upgradeButton.Upgrade.Visible = false
				upgradeButton.UpgradeCost.Visible = false
				upgradeButton.MidUpgrade.Visible = true
			else
				local v374 = v28:GetAbilityUpgradePrice(v370)
				local v375 = v374 and v374 > 0

				upgradeButton.ImageLabel.Visible = v375
				upgradeButton.Upgrade.Visible = v375
				upgradeButton.UpgradeCost.Visible = v375
				upgradeButton.MidUpgrade.Visible = false

				if v375 then
					upgradeButton.UpgradeCost.Text = v374
				elseif itemInfo.Upgrade.CustomUpgrade then
					upgradeButton.MidUpgrade.Visible = true
					upgradeButton.MidUpgrade.Text = "Upgrade"
				end

				local v376 = itemInfo.Upgrade.KillRequirements[v372 + 1]

				if v376 then
					killsProgressBar.Visible = true

					local v377

					if itemInfo.Attributes.UseLegacyUpgradeProgression then
						local v378 = v16.getReplionPathState(p26.DataReplion, "TotalStats.Kills")
						local v379 = p29(v378)
						local getReplionPathState = v16.getReplionPathState
						local dataReplion = p26.DataReplion
						local v382 = ("AbilityUpgradeProgression.%*"):format(itemInfo.Name)
						local v383 = getReplionPathState(dataReplion, v382)
						local v384 = p29(v383)

						v377 = math.clamp((v379 or 0) - (v384 or 0), 0, v376)
					else
						local v385 = v16.getReplionPathState
						local v386 = p26.DataReplion
						local v387 = ("NewAbilityUpgradeProgression.%*"):format(itemInfo.Name)
						local v388 = v385(v386, v387)
						local v389 = p29(v388)

						v377 = math.clamp(v389 or 0, 0, v376)
					end

					killsProgressBar.Progress.Text = ("%*/%* Elims"):format(v377, v376)
					killsProgressBar.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(v377 / v376, 0.9)
				end
			end

			for i = 1, maxUpgrade do
				local clone = v158:Clone(controllerShop.Templates.AbilityUpgradeTemplate)

				clone.Visible = true
				clone.LayoutOrder = i

				if v372 >= i then
					clone.Image = "rbxassetid://15645666568"
				end

				clone.Parent = upgrades
			end
		end

		return nil
	end)
	v30.animateButtonClick(upgradeButton)
	v30.animateButtonClick(equipButton)
	v30.animateButtonClick(favorite)
	favorite.Activated:Connect(function()
		local v392 = t5.Ability:Get()

			v28:ToggleFavorited(v392)
		end
	end)

function module.GeneralHandler(_, _, _, p52, p53)
	local itemTitle = p53:WaitForChild("ItemTitle")
	local desc = p53:WaitForChild("Desc")
	local itemInfo = p52.ItemInfo

	if itemInfo.Icon then
		local image = itemInfo.Attributes and itemInfo.Attributes.AltIcon or p52.ItemInfo.Icon
		local itemIcon = p53:WaitForChild("ItemIcon")

		itemIcon.Visible = true
		itemIcon.Image = image
	end

	if itemInfo.Description then
		desc.Text = itemInfo.Description
	end

	itemTitle.Text = itemInfo.DisplayName or itemInfo.Name
end
function module.SetupPageRight(p54)
	local v200 = v10.new()
	local v201 = v10.new()

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in module.PageInfo, nil, nil do
		local pageName = iterSecond.PageName
		local right = controllerShopMain.Pages:WaitForChild(pageName):WaitForChild("Right")
		local itemState = iterSecond.ItemState

		v16.Computed(function(p55)
			local v456 = p55(itemState)

			if not v456 then
				return nil
			end

			local itemInfo = v456.ItemInfo
			local u458: boolean = table.find(t3, itemInfo.ItemType) ~= nil
			local v459 = u458 and right:FindFirstChild("Rap")

			if v459 then
				v459.Coins.Amount.Text = "---"

				local visible = u458 and v33:IsEnabled() and v33:ShouldShowRAP(itemInfo.ItemType, itemInfo.Name)

				v459.Visible = visible

				if visible then
					v459.Coins.Amount.Text = v15.ValueConvertor:AddCommas(p55(v456.RAP))
				end
			end

			local existCount = right:FindFirstChild("ExistCount")

			if existCount then
				local v462 = v35:Get(itemInfo.ItemType, v456.ParsedItemKey)

				if v462 then
					existCount.Label.Text = ("%* Exist%*"):format(v15.ValueConvertor:ShrinkNumber(v462), if v462 == 1 then "s" else "")
				end

				existCount.Visible = v462 ~= nil
			end

			p54:GeneralHandler(p55, pageName, v456, right)

			return nil
		end)
	end

	p54:SelectedAbilityHandler(v201)
	p54:SelectedExplosion(v200)
	p54:SelectedSwordHandler(v200)
	p54:SelectedRobux(v200)
end

function module.RenderSword(p56, p57, p58)
	local itemInfo = p57.ItemInfo
	local v211 = client:KeyToItem(p57.ParsedItemKey)
	local clone = controllerShop.Templates.SwordTemplate:Clone()

	clone.Visible = true
	t11.Sword[p57.ParsedItemKey] = clone

	if itemInfo.Icon then
		clone.ViewportFrame.Visible = false
		clone.ItemIcon.Visible = true
		clone.ItemIcon.Image = itemInfo.Icon
	else
		clone.ViewportFrame.Visible = true
		clone.ItemIcon.Visible = false
		v9:SetSwordIconAsViewportByName(clone.ViewportFrame, itemInfo.Name)
	end

	clone.ItemName.Text = itemInfo.DisplayName
	clone.ImageColor3 = t9[itemInfo.Rarity] or t9.Normal

	local v213 = v211.Finisher and replicatedStorage2.Misc.DataFinishers:FindFirstChild(itemInfo.Name)

	if v213 then
		local clone2 = script.NewInventory.Finisher:Clone()

		clone2.Icon.Image = v213:GetAttribute("Icon") or v15.Icons:GetIcon("DEFAULT_MISSING")
		clone2.Parent = clone
	end

	p58:Add(v221)

	local sword = v49.Sword
	local v223 = v52.Sword

	p58:Add(v16.setPropertyComputed(clone, "Name", function(p61)
		local v470 = if sword then p61(sword) else "Default"
		local v471 = if v223 then p61(v223) else Enum.SortDirection.Ascending
