	end))
	p58:Add(v16.setPropertyComputed(clone, "LayoutOrder", function(p62)
		local v473 = if sword then p62(sword) else "Default"
		local v474 = if v223 then p62(v223) else Enum.SortDirection.Ascending
		local v475 = t10[v474]

		if v473 == "RAP" then
			return (p62(p57.RAP) or 0) * v475
		end

		if v473 == "Exists" then
			return (p62(v213) or 0) * v475
		end

		if v473 == "Creation Date" then
			return ((p57.ItemInfo.CreatedAt or 0) - 888347471) * v475
		end

		return p62(v220) or 0
	end))

	local favorite = clone:WaitForChild("Favorite")

	favorite.Visible = false
	p58:Add(v16.Computed(function(p63)
		favorite.Visible = p63(p57.IsFavorited)

		return nil
	end))
	p58:Add(v16.setPropertyComputed(clone, "Visible", function(p64)
		local u478 = not itemInfo.Hidden

		if not u478 then
			u478 = true

			local v479 = p57

			if not (p64(v479.OwnedCopies) - (p64(v56) and p64(module:GetDeletingItemState(v479)) or 0) > 0) then
				u478 = itemInfo.AlwaysVisible
			end
		end

		return u478
	end))
	p58:Add(v16.Computed(function(p65)
		local v481 = p57
		local v482 = p65(v481.OwnedCopies)
		local v483 = p65(v56) and p65(module:GetDeletingItemState(v481)) or 0
		local n1 = v482 - v483
		local stack = clone:FindFirstChild("Stack")

		if stack then
			stack.Visible = n1 > 1

			if n1 > 1 and stack then
				stack.Label.Text = ("x%*"):format((v15.ValueConvertor:AddCommas(n1)))
			end
		end

local t12: {[any]: any} = {
	All = function(_, _)
		return true
	end,
	Owned = function(p6, p7)
		if p6.OwnedCopies then
			return p7(p6.OwnedCopies) > 0
		end

		return true
	end,
	Unowned = function(p8, p9)
		if p8.OwnedCopies then
			return p9(p8.OwnedCopies) <= 0
		end

		return false
	end
}

function module.RenderSlot(p88, p89)
	local v268 = client:KeyToItem(p89.ParsedItemKey)
	local itemInfo = p89.ItemInfo
	local itemInfoItemType = itemInfo.ItemType

	if not itemInfo then
		local v271 = ("Player owns non-existent sword \"%*\""):format(v268.Name)

		warn(v271)

		return
	end

	local s1 = if itemInfo.ItemType == "GamePass" or itemInfo.ItemType == "DevProduct" then "Robux" else itemInfo.ItemType
	local v273 = module.PageInfo[s1]
	local v274 = v28:ParseItemKey(itemInfoItemType, v268)
	local v275 = v28:ParseItemKey(itemInfoItemType, { Name = v268.Name })
	local u276: boolean = v274 == v275

	if itemInfo.IsInventorey then
		local itemInfoAlwaysShow = itemInfo.AlwaysShow
		local v278 = p89.OwnedCopies:Get()
		local v279 = v56:Get() and module:GetDeletingItemState(p89):Get() or 0
		local v280 = v28.OwnedBases[itemInfoItemType][v268.Name].State:Get()

		if not (v278 - v279 > 0) and (not itemInfoAlwaysShow or not u276 or not not v280) then
			return
		end
	end

	v274 = v10.new()

	local u281 = nil

	if itemInfo.ItemType == "Sword" then
		u281 = module:RenderSword(p89, v274)
	elseif itemInfo.ItemType == "Explosion" then
		u281 = module:RenderExplosion(p89, v274)
	elseif itemInfo.ItemType == "Ability" then
		u281 = module:RenderAbility(p89, v274)
	elseif itemInfo.ItemType == "DevProduct" then
		u281 = module:RenderDevProduct(p89, v274)
	elseif itemInfo.ItemType == "GamePass" then
		u281 = module:RenderGamePass(p89, v274)
	end

	if u281 then
		u281:SetAttribute("ParsedItemKey", p89.ParsedItemKey)
		v274:Add(u281)
		v274:Add(function()
			t11[itemInfoItemType][p89.ParsedItemKey] = nil
		end)
	end

	local u282 = nil

	if itemInfo.IsInventorey then
		local v283 = v28:GetItemData(itemInfoItemType, p89.ParsedItemKey)

		u282 = v16.Computed(function(p90)
			local u508 = true
			local v509 = v283
			local v510 = p90(v509.OwnedCopies)
			local v511 = p90(v56) and p90(module:GetDeletingItemState(v509)) or 0

			if not (v510 - v511 > 0) then
				if u276 then
					u508 = itemInfo.AlwaysShow

					if u508 then
						return not p90(v28.OwnedBases[itemInfoItemType][v268.Name].State)
					end
				else
					u508 = false
				end

				return u508
			end

			return u508
		end)
		v23:Add(u281, itemInfoItemType, v268, v283.ParsedItemKey)
	end

	local v284 = t4[s1]
	local t15: {[any]: any} = { itemInfo.DisplayName or itemInfo.Name }

	if itemInfo.ItemType ~= "Sword" then
		if itemInfo.ItemType == "Ability" then
			local text: string = tostring(v268.Upgrade or 0)

			table.insert(t15, text)
		end
	elseif v268.Finisher then
		table.insert(t15, "Finisher")
	end

	local lowerText = table.concat(t15, "|"):lower()

	if itemInfo.IsInventorey then
		local v288 = v28:GetItemData(itemInfoItemType, p89.ParsedItemKey)
		local alwaysShow = itemInfo.AlwaysShow
		local state = v28.OwnedBases[itemInfoItemType][v268.Name].State
		local v291 = v288.OwnedCopies:Get()
		local v292 = v56:Get() and module:GetDeletingItemState(v288):Get() or 0

		if not (v291 - v292 > 0) and (not alwaysShow or not u276 or state:Get()) then
			v274:Destroy()

			return
		end

		v274:Add(v16.Computed(function(p91)
			local v513 = v288
			local v514 = p91(v513.OwnedCopies)
			local v515 = p91(v56) and p91(module:GetDeletingItemState(v513)) or 0

			if not (v514 - v515 > 0) and (not alwaysShow or not u276 or p91(state)) then
				task.defer(function()
					local v632 = v288
					local v633 = v632.OwnedCopies:Get()
					local v634 = v56:Get() and module:GetDeletingItemState(v632):Get() or 0

					if not (v633 - v634 > 0) and (not alwaysShow or not u276 or state:Get()) then
						v274:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end

			return nil
		end))
	end

	if not u281 then
		return
	end

	if v268.TradeLock and v268.TradeLock.Value then
		local clone = script.NewInventory.Lock:Clone()

		clone.Parent = u281
		v274:Add(v16.Computed(function(p92)
			local v517 = v16.getReplionPathState(p88.DataReplion, "HasInteractedWithTrading")

			clone.Visible = p92(v517)

			return nil
		end))
	end

	local pageName = v273.PageName
	local foundChild = controllerShopMain.Pages:FindFirstChild(pageName)

	u281.Activated:Connect(function()
		if v56:Get() then
			local v518, v519 = v21.IsDeleteable(LocalPlayer, itemInfoItemType, v268)

			if not v518 then
				if v519 then
					v26:SendNotification(v519)
				end

				return
			end

			if p89.OwnedCopies and p89.OwnedCopies:Get() <= 0 then
				v26:SendNotification("You don't own this item!")

				return
			end

			local v520 = p88:GetDeletingItemState(p89)
			local v521 = v520:Get()

			v520:Set(v521 + 1)

			return
		end

		v273.ItemState:Set(p89)

		if t7[pageName] and foundChild then
			foundChild.RandomizerView.Visible = false
			v64:SetTag("Shuffle", false)
			v77:FireServer(t7[pageName], false, false)
		end
	end)
	v274:Add(v16.Computed(function(p93)
		if p93(v58) ~= v273.PageName then
			return nil
		end

		local v523 = p93(all)

		if itemInfo.ItemType == "DevProduct" or itemInfo.ItemType == "GamePass" then
			v523 = "All"
		end

		local v524 = (if u282 then p93(u282) else true) and t12[v523](p89, p93)
		local v525 = v284 and p93(v284)

		if v525 then
			local v526 = v524

			if v526 then
				v526 = true

				if v525 ~= lowerText then
					v526 = true

					if v525 ~= lowerText:sub(1, #v525) then
						v526 = lowerText:find(v525, 1, true) ~= nil
					end
				end
			end

			v524 = v526
		end

		u281.Visible = v524

		return nil
	end))
	v30.animateButtonClick(u281)
	v30.animateButtonHover(u281)

	return u281
end

function module.Start(p99)
	local dataReplion = v12.Client:WaitReplion("Data")

	p99.DataReplion = dataReplion

	local tabs = controllerShopMainTop:WaitForChild("Tabs")
	local coinValue = controllerShopMainTop:WaitForChild("CoinValue")
	local t16: {[any]: any} = { "Ability", "Explosion", "Sword", "Robux" }
	local t17: {[any]: any} = { "All", "Owned", "Unowned" }
	local color38 = Color3.fromRGB(63, 63, 63)
	local color39 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 126, 21)

	controllerShopMain.ConsoleKeys.L1.Activated:Connect(function()
		local v527 = v58:Get()
		local v528 = table.find(t16, v527)

		v528 = math.max(1, (v528 - 2) % #t16 + 1)

		local v529 = t16[v528]

		v58:Set(v529)

		local v530 = t13[v529] and t13[v529][1]

		if not v530 then
			return
		end

		all:Set(v530)
	end)
	controllerShopMain.ConsoleKeys.R1.Activated:Connect(function()
		local v531 = v58:Get()
		local v532 = table.find(t16, v531)
		local v533 = math.max(1, v532 % #t16 + 1)
		local v534 = t16[v533]

		v58:Set(v534)
		v532 = t13[v534] and t13[v534][1]

		if not v532 then
			return
		end

		all:Set(v532)
	end)
	controllerShopMain.ConsoleKeys.Circle.Activated:Connect(function()
		v18:Close()
	end)

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in controllerShopMain.Top.Tabs:GetChildren() do
		if iterSecond:IsA("GuiButton") then
			iterSecond.Activated:Connect(function()
				v58:Set(iterSecond.Name)
			end)
		end
	end

	local popUpTokensBuy = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("PopUpTokensBuy")

	for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in controllerShopMain.Pages:GetChildren() do
		if iterSecond2:IsA("Frame") then
			local v315 = iterSecond2.Name

			if tabs:FindFirstChild(v315) then
				v16.setPropertyState(iterSecond2.FrameUI, "Visible", v62)

				if iterSecond2:FindFirstChild("Top") then
					v16.setPropertyState(iterSecond2.Top, "Visible", v62)
				end

				v16.setPropertyState(iterSecond2.Right, "Visible", v65)
				v16.Computed(function(p100)
					local visible: boolean = p100(v58) == v315

					v537.Image = if visible then "rbxassetid://15643806432" else "rbxassetid://15643737651"
					v537.Text.UIStroke.Color = visible and color39 or color38
					iterSecond2.Visible = visible

					local scrolling = iterSecond2.FrameUI.Scrolling
					local v539 = v16.getPropertyState(popUpTokensBuy, "Enabled")

					scrolling.ScrollingEnabled = not p100(v539)

					return nil
				end)

				local searchFrame = iterSecond2:FindFirstChild("SearchFrame")

				if searchFrame then
					local function updateInput()
						local text = searchFrame.Input.Box.Text

						if text and #text > 0 then
							p99.PagesSearchs[v315]:Set(text:lower())

							return
						end

						p99.PagesSearchs[v315]:Set()
					end

					searchFrame.Input.Box.Changed:Connect(updateInput)
					searchFrame.Search.Activated:Connect(updateInput)

					local v318 = v49[v315]
					local v319 = v52[v315]

					if searchFrame:FindFirstChild("Sort") then
						for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in searchFrame.Sort.List:GetChildren() do
							if iterSecond3:IsA("GuiObject") then
								local v322 = iterSecond3.Name

								v16.Computed(function(p101)
									local u542: boolean = p101(v318) == iterSecond3.Name

									iterSecond3.Image = if u542 then "rbxassetid://18123223527" else "rbxassetid://18123248161"
									iterSecond3.HoverImage = if u542 then "rbxassetid://18123872657" else "rbxassetid://18123874724"
									iterSecond3.Label.UIStroke.Color = u542 and Color3.fromRGB(149, 67, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(21, 56, 169)

									return nil
								end)
								iterSecond3.Activated:Connect(function()
									if v318:Get() == iterSecond3.Name then
										local v543 = v319:Get()

										v319:Set(if v543 == Enum.SortDirection.Ascending then Enum.SortDirection.Descending else Enum.SortDirection.Ascending)

										return
									end

									v318:Set(iterSecond3.Name)
									v319:Set(Enum.SortDirection.Ascending)

									if v322 == "Default" or v322 == "Alphabetical" then
										iterSecond2.FrameUI.Scrolling.UIGridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.Name

										return
									end

									iterSecond2.FrameUI.Scrolling.UIGridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
								end)
							end
						end

						v16.Computed(function(p102)
							if p102(v319) == Enum.SortDirection.Ascending then
								searchFrame.Sort.Arrow.Rotation = 180
							else
								searchFrame.Sort.Arrow.Rotation = 0
							end

							return nil
						end)

						local u323: boolean = false

						searchFrame.Sort.Activated:Connect(function()
							u323 = not u323
							searchFrame.Sort.List.Visible = u323
						end)
					end

					if searchFrame:FindFirstChild("Delete") then
						searchFrame.Delete.Activated:Connect(function()
							local v545 = v56:Get()

							v56:Set(not v545)

	if v264 then
		local cFrame = CFrame.new(v264.Position + v264.Normal.Unit * 0.1)

		instance:PivotTo(cFrame * v263)
	else
		local cFrame = CFrame.new(explodePosition)

		instance:PivotTo(cFrame * v263)

	v11.Visual:PlayEffects(instance)

	local pivot = instance.Sword1:GetPivot()

		instance.Sword1:PivotTo(pivot * p36)
	end)

	local cFrame = instance.Sword1.Blade:GetAttribute("CFrame")

	tweenService:Create(cFrameValue, tweenInfo, { Value = cFrame }):Play()

	local cFrameValue2: CFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")

	cFrameValue2.Value = CFrame.identity

	local pivot2 = instance.Sword2:GetPivot()

	cFrameValue2.Changed:Connect(function(p37: CFrame)
		instance.Sword2:PivotTo(pivot2 * p37)
	end)

	local tweenInfo15 = TweenInfo.new(0.225, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	local cFrame2 = instance.Sword2.Blade:GetAttribute("CFrame")

	tweenService:Create(cFrameValue2, tweenInfo15, { Value = cFrame2 }):Play()
	task.delay(3.9, function()
		v11.Visual:TurnOffVisuals(instance)

		local t12: {[any]: any} = {}

		for iterFirst, iterSecond in instance.Sword1:GetDescendants() do
			table.insert(t12, iterSecond)
		end

		for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in instance.Sword2:GetDescendants() do
			table.insert(t12, iterSecond2)
		end

		for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in t12, nil, nil do
			if iterSecond3:IsA("BasePart") or iterSecond3:IsA("Decal") then
				local tweenInfo16 = TweenInfo.new(0.225, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)

				tweenService:Create(iterSecond3, tweenInfo16, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
			elseif iterSecond3:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or iterSecond3:IsA("Beam") or iterSecond3:IsA("Trail") then
				iterSecond3.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end)
	debris:AddItem(instance.Sword1, 4)
	debris:AddItem(instance.Sword2, 4)
	debris:AddItem(instance, 8)
	debris:AddItem(cFrameValue, 8)
	debris:AddItem(cFrameValue2, 8)

		workspace.Alive,
		workspace.MapBounds,
		workspace.Runtime
	}

	local v357 = workspace:Raycast(explodePosition, Vector3.new(-0, -50, -0), raycastParams)

	if v357 then
		local cFrame = CFrame.new(v357.Position + v357.Normal.Unit * 0.1)

		instance:PivotTo(cFrame * v356)

		instance:PivotTo(cFrame * v356)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local pivot = instance.Parasol:GetPivot()

		instance.Parasol:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 1000000000, 0))

		local animationTrack = instance.Parasol.AnimationController.Animator:LoadAnimation(instance.Parasol.Animation)

		while animationTrack.Length == 0 and instance.Parent do
			task.wait()

		if not instance.Parent then
			return

		instance.Parasol:PivotTo(pivot)
		animationTrack:Play(0)
		v11.Visual:PlayEffects(instance)
		task.delay(3.95, function()
			instance.Parasol:Destroy()
			animationTrack:Stop(0)
			animationTrack:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
	debris:AddItem(instance, 10)
end

module.Specific["Soul Lantern"] = function(p70)
	local explodePosition = p70.ExplodePosition
	local instance = p70.Instance

	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		instance,
		workspace.Dead,
		workspace.Alive,
		workspace.MapBounds,
		workspace.Runtime
	}

	local v516 = CFrame.fromOrientation(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
	local v517 = workspace:Raycast(explodePosition, Vector3.new(-0, -50, -0), raycastParams)

	if v517 then
		local cFrame = CFrame.new(v517.Position + v517.Normal.Unit * 0.1)

		instance:PivotTo(cFrame * v516)
	else
		local cFrame = CFrame.new(explodePosition)

		instance:PivotTo(cFrame * v516)
	end

	v11.Visual:PlayEffects(instance)

	local cFrameValue: CFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")

	cFrameValue.Value = CFrame.identity

	local vector3Value: Vector3Value = Instance.new("Vector3Value")

	vector3Value.Value = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

	local pivot = instance.Lantern:GetPivot()

	local function update()
		local vector3ValueValue: Vector3 = vector3Value.Value
		local lantern = instance.Lantern
		local n1 = pivot * cFrameValue.Value
		local v1138 = CFrame.fromOrientation(vector3ValueValue.X, vector3ValueValue.Y, vector3ValueValue.Z)

		lantern:PivotTo(n1 * v1138)
	end

	vector3Value.Changed:Connect(update)
	cFrameValue.Changed:Connect(update)

	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.225, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	local value = parseCFrame(instance.Lantern["lantern 1"]:GetAttribute("CFrame"))

	tweenService:Create(cFrameValue, tweenInfo, { Value = value }):Play()

	local n1: number = -0.25

	local connection = runService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(deltaTimeSim: number)
		local cFrameLookAt = CFrame.lookAt
		local pivot6 = instance.Lantern:GetPivot()
		local cFrame = cFrameLookAt(pivot6.Position, CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)

		n1 += deltaTimeSim

		local v1143 = select(2, cFrame:ToOrientation())
		local v1144 = math.sin(if n1 > 0 then n1 * 2 else 0)

		vector3Value.Value = Vector3.new(0, v1143 + 1.5707963267948966, v1144 * 0.35)
	end)

	task.delay(3.75, function()
		for iterFirst, iterSecond in instance.Lantern:GetDescendants() do
			if iterSecond:IsA("BasePart") then
				iterSecond.Transparency = 1
			elseif iterSecond:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and iterSecond.Parent.Name ~= "VanishTransition" then
				iterSecond.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(4, function()
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)
	debris:AddItem(instance, 8)
	debris:AddItem(cFrameValue, 8)
	debris:AddItem(vector3Value, 8)
	instance.Lantern.Destroying:Connect(function()
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)
end

module.Specific["Soul Counter"] = function(p91)
	autoPlay(p91)

	local kill = p91.Kill
	local clone = replicatedStorage2.Assets.R6:Clone()

	clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new(p91.ExplodePosition))
	clone.Parent = workspace.Runtime

	if kill then
		local billboard: Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")

		billboard.Name = "Billboard"
		billboard.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 9.61242294, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)

		local infoBillboard: BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

		infoBillboard.Name = "InfoBillboard"
		infoBillboard.Active = true
		infoBillboard.ExtentsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
		infoBillboard.MaxDistance = 100
		infoBillboard.Size = UDim2.new(25, 5, 5, 5)
		infoBillboard.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

		local textLabel: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

		textLabel.Name = "TextLabel"
		textLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		textLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		textLabel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(27, 42, 53)
		textLabel.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/FredokaOne.json")
		textLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.4)
		textLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.2, 1.5)
		textLabel.Text = v11.ValueConvertor:AddCommas(kill)
		textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		textLabel.TextScaled = true
		textLabel.TextSize = 14
		textLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
		textLabel.TextWrapped = true
		textLabel.ZIndex = 2

		local uiStroke: UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

		uiStroke.Name = "UIStroke"
		uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
		uiStroke.Thickness = 2
		uiStroke.Parent = textLabel

		local uiGradient: UIGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")

		uiGradient.Name = "UIGradient"

		local colorSequenceNew = ColorSequence.new

		uiGradient.Color = colorSequenceNew({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 231, 97)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.463, Color3.fromRGB(255, 252, 121)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(118, 103, 47))
		})
		uiGradient.Rotation = 90
		uiGradient.Parent = textLabel
		textLabel.Parent = infoBillboard
		infoBillboard.Parent = billboard
		billboard.Parent = clone.Head
	end

	local t5: {[any]: any} = {}

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in clone:GetDescendants() do
		if iterSecond:IsA("BasePart") or iterSecond:IsA("Decal") or iterSecond:IsA("Texture") or iterSecond:IsA("Highlight") then
			table.insert(t5, iterSecond)
		end
	end

	clone.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p92)
		if p92:IsA("BasePart") or p92:IsA("Decal") or p92:IsA("Texture") or p92:IsA("Highlight") then
			table.insert(t5, p92)
		end
	end)
	clone.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true

	local cFrameValue: CFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")

	cFrameValue.Value = CFrame.identity

	local numberValue: NumberValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")

	numberValue.Value = 0

	local pivot = clone:GetPivot()

	local function update()
		clone:PivotTo(pivot * cFrameValue.Value)

		for iterFirst, iterSecond in t5, nil, nil do
			if iterSecond.ClassName == "Highlight" then
				iterSecond.OutlineTransparency = numberValue.Value
				iterSecond.FillTransparency = numberValue.Value
			else
				iterSecond.Transparency = numberValue.Value
			end
		end
	end

	cFrameValue.Changed:Connect(update)
	numberValue.Changed:Connect(update)

	local fastTween = v9.fastTween
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(3.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)

	fastTween(cFrameValue, tweenInfo, { Value = CFrame.new(0, 15, 0) })

	local v701 = v9.fastTween
	local tweenInfo23 = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, 0, false, 2.5)

	v701(numberValue, tweenInfo23, { Value = 1 })

	local highlight: Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

module.Specific["Lunar Lantern"] = function(p93)
	local explodePosition = p93.ExplodePosition
	local instance = p93.Instance

	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		instance,
		workspace.Dead,
		workspace.Alive,
		workspace.MapBounds,
		workspace.Runtime
	}

	local v711 = CFrame.fromOrientation(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
	local v712 = workspace:Raycast(explodePosition, Vector3.new(-0, -50, -0), raycastParams)

	if v712 then
		local cFrame = CFrame.new(v712.Position + v712.Normal.Unit * 0.1)

		instance:PivotTo(cFrame * v711)
	else
		local cFrame = CFrame.new(explodePosition)

		instance:PivotTo(cFrame * v711)
	end

	v11.Visual:PlayEffects(instance)

	local cFrameValue: CFrameValue = Instance.new("CFrameValue")

	cFrameValue.Value = CFrame.identity

	local vector3Value: Vector3Value = Instance.new("Vector3Value")

	vector3Value.Value = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

	local pivot = instance.Lantern:GetPivot()

	local function update()
		local vector3ValueValue: Vector3 = vector3Value.Value
		local lantern = instance.Lantern
		local n1 = pivot * cFrameValue.Value
		local v1250 = CFrame.fromOrientation(vector3ValueValue.X, vector3ValueValue.Y, vector3ValueValue.Z)

		lantern:PivotTo(n1 * v1250)
	end

	vector3Value.Changed:Connect(update)
	cFrameValue.Changed:Connect(update)

	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.225, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	local value = parseCFrame(instance.Lantern["lantern 1"]:GetAttribute("CFrame"))

	tweenService:Create(cFrameValue, tweenInfo, { Value = value }):Play()

	local n1: number = -0.25

	local connection = runService.PostSimulation:Connect(function(deltaTimeSim: number)
		local cFrameLookAt = CFrame.lookAt
		local pivot15 = instance.Lantern:GetPivot()
		local cFrame = cFrameLookAt(pivot15.Position, CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position)

		n1 += deltaTimeSim

		local v1255 = select(2, cFrame:ToOrientation())
		local v1256 = math.sin(if n1 > 0 then n1 * 2 else 0)

		vector3Value.Value = Vector3.new(0, v1255 + 1.5707963267948966, v1256 * 0.35)
	end)

	task.delay(3.85, function()
		for iterFirst, iterSecond in instance.Lantern:GetDescendants() do
			if iterSecond:IsA("BasePart") then
				iterSecond.Transparency = 1
			elseif iterSecond:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and iterSecond.Parent.Name ~= "VanishTransition" then
				iterSecond.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(4, function()
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)
	debris:AddItem(instance, 8)
	debris:AddItem(cFrameValue, 8)
	debris:AddItem(vector3Value, 8)
	instance.Lantern.Destroying:Connect(function()
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)
end

module.Specific["Master Builder"] = function(p98)
	local v746 = v10.new()
	local dragon = p98.Instance.Dragon
	local cFrame = CFrame.new(p98.ExplodePosition)

	raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		p98.Instance,
		workspace.Dead,
		workspace.Alive,
		workspace.MapBounds,
		workspace.Runtime
	}

	local v749 = workspace:Raycast(cFrame.Position, Vector3.new(-0, -50, -0), raycastParams)

	if v749 then
		cFrame = CFrame.new(v749.Position + v749.Normal.Unit * 0.1)
	end

	local cFrameAngles = CFrame.Angles
	local randomNumber = math.random()
	local v752 = cFrameAngles(0, randomNumber * 3.141592653589793 * 2, 0)
	local n1 = cFrame * v752

	dragon:PivotTo(n1)

	local dragonBuilt = dragon.Built
	local dragonBroken = dragon.Broken
	local t6: {[any]: any} = {}

	for iterFirst, iterSecond in dragonBroken:GetChildren() do
		if iterSecond:IsA("BasePart") then
			local foundChild = dragonBuilt:FindFirstChild(iterSecond.Name)

			if not foundChild then
				iterSecond:Destroy()
			else
				local random = Random.new()

				iterSecond.CFrame = n1
				iterSecond.Anchored = false
				task.delay(0, function()
					local v1276 = random:NextUnitVector().Unit

					if v1276 ~= v1276 then
						v1276 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					end

					local vector3 = Vector3.new(0, 100 * iterSecond.Mass, 0)

					iterSecond:ApplyImpulse(vector3 + v1276 * iterSecond.Mass * 15)
					task.wait(0.1)
					iterSecond.CanCollide = true
				end)
				table.insert(t6, { Part = iterSecond, CFrame = foundChild.CFrame })
			end
		end
	end

	local v761 = dragonBuilt.foot_L.Position:Lerp(dragonBuilt.foot_R.Position, 0.5)

	dragonBuilt:Destroy()
	dragon.Parent = workspace.Runtime
	v746:AttachToInstance(dragon)
	table.sort(t6, function(p99, p100)
		local CFramePosition = p99.CFrame.Position
		local vector3 = Vector3.new(0, p99.Part.Size.Y / 2)
		local magnitude = (CFramePosition - vector3 - v761).Magnitude
		local v1283 = p100.CFrame.Position
		local vector32 = Vector3.new(0, p100.Part.Size.Y / 2, 0)

		return magnitude < (v1283 - vector32 - v761).Magnitude
	end)
	task.wait(0.75)

	for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in t6, nil, nil do
		iterSecond2.Part.Anchored = true
		iterSecond2.Part.CanCollide = false

		local v764 = math.clamp((iterSecond2.Part.Position - iterSecond2.CFrame.Position).Magnitude / 45 / (iterFirst2 * 0.2 + 1), 0.2, 1)
		local part = iterSecond2.Part
		local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(v764, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

		v746:Add(tweenService:Create(part, tweenInfo, { CFrame = iterSecond2.CFrame })):Play()
		task.wait(v764)
	end

	for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in t6, nil, nil do
		local v769 = iterSecond3.Part
		local tweenInfo24 = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, true)

		v746:Add(tweenService:Create(v769, tweenInfo24, { CFrame = iterSecond3.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0) })):Play()
	end

	task.wait(0.5)

	local highlight: Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

	highlight.Name = "Highlight"
	highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 0)
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.3
	highlight.Parent = dragonBroken

	local tweenInfo25 = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, 0, false, 0.15)

	v746:Add(tweenService:Create(highlight, tweenInfo25, { FillTransparency = 1, OutlineTransparency = 1 })):Play()

	for iterFirst4, iterSecond4 in t6, nil, nil do
		v746:Add(tweenService:Create(iterSecond4.Part, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Transparency = 0.999 })):Play()
	end

	task.wait(2)
	v746:Destroy()
end

				t23 = to_str_arr(v373 .. "")
			elseif t21.o then
				local v379 = string.format
				local typeName4: string = type(v373)
				local v381 = v379("invalid replacement value (a %s)", typeName4)

				error(v381, 3)
			else
				t23 = { n = 0 }
			end
		end

		local n10 = v369[0][2] - v369[0][1]
		local v383 = math.min(t23.n, n10)

		for i = 0, v383 - 1 do
			v365[v369[0][1] + i] = t23[i + 1]
		end

		local n11 = v369[0][1] + v383

		n7 = v369[0][2]

		if n10 > t23.n then
			for _ = 1, n10 - t23.n do
				table.remove(v365, n11)
				n6 -= 1
				n7 -= 1
			end
		elseif n10 < t23.n then
			for i = 1, t23.n - n10 do
				table.insert(v365, n11 + i - 1, t23[v383 + i])
				n6 += 1
				n7 += 1
			end
		end

		if n10 <= 0 then
			n7 += 1
		end

		n8 += 1

		if p57 < n8 + 1 then
			break
		end
	end

	return from_str_arr(v365), n8
end

local function v36(p60, p61, p62)
	if tonumber(p62) then
		p62 = tonumber(p62)

		if p62 <= -1 or p62 ~= p62 then
			p62 = math.huge
		end
	elseif p62 == nil then
		p62 = math.huge
	else
		local stringFormat = string.format
		local typeName: string = typeof(p62)

		error(v393, 3)
	end

	local v394 = to_str_arr(p61)
	local n1 = 1
	local n2: number = 0
	local t24: {[any]: any} = {}
	local n3: number = 0

	while n1 <= v394.n + 1 do
		n2 += 1

		local u399 = false

		if p62 >= n2 then
			u399 = re_rawfind(p60.token, v394, n1, p60.flags, p60.verb_flags, false)
		end

		if not u399 then
			break
		end

		local s = v394.s
		local v401 = utf8.offset(s, u399[0][1])
		local v402 = utf8.offset(s, n1 - n3)
		local v403 = string.sub(s, v402, v401 and v401 - 1)

		table.insert(t24, v403)
		n3 = if u399[0][1] >= u399[0][2] then 1 else 0
		n1 = u399[0][2] + n3
	end

	local v404 = string.sub(v394.s, utf8.offset(v394.s, n1 - n3))

	table.insert(t24, v404)

	return t24
end

local function tokenize_ptn(p66, p67)
	local brk0: boolean = false

	if p67.unicode then
		return "options.unicodeData cannot be turned off while having unicode flag"
	end

	local n1 = 1
	local n = p66.n
	local n2 = 0
	local t25: {[any]: any} = {}
	local t26: {[any]: any} = {}
	local t27: {[any]: any} = { newline = 1, newline_seq = 1, not_empty = 0 }

	while n1 <= n do
		local v506 = p66[n1]

		if v506 == 40 then
			local t28 = nil

			if p66[n1 + 1] == 42 then
				n1 += 2

				local n3: number = n1

				while p66[n1] and (p66[n1] >= 48 and p66[n1] <= 57 or p66[n1] >= 65 and p66[n1] <= 90 or p66[n1] >= 97 and p66[n1] <= 122 or p66[n1] == 95 or p66[n1] == 58) do
					n1 += 1
				end

				if p66[n1] ~= 41 and p66[n1 - 1] ~= 58 then
					return "quantifier doesn't follow a repeatable pattern"
				end

				local s = p66.s
				local v510 = utf8.offset(s, n1)
				local v511 = utf8.offset(s, n3)
				local v512 = string.sub(s, v511, v510 and v510 - 1)

				if v512 == "positive_lookahead:" or v512 == "negative_lookhead:" or v512 == "positive_lookbehind:" or v512 == "negative_lookbehind:" or v512:find("^[pn]l[ab]:$") then
					local v513 = v512:find("^n")
					local v514 = v512:find("b", 3, true)
					t28 = {
						40,
						nil,
						nil,
						if v513 then 33 else 61,
						v514 and 1
					}
				elseif v512 == "atomic:" then
					t28 = { 40, nil, nil, 62, nil }
				elseif v512 == "ACCEPT" or v512 == "FAIL" or v512 == "F" or v512 == "PRUNE" or v512 == "SKIP" then
					t28 = if v512 == "F" then "FAIL" else v512
				else
					if t14[v512] then
						t27.newline = v512
					elseif v512 == "BSR_ANYCRLF" or v512 == "BSR_UNICODE" then
						t27.newline_seq = if v512 == "BSR_UNICODE" then 1 else 0
					else
						if v512 ~= "NOTEMPTY" and v512 ~= "NOTEMPTY_ATSTART" then
							return "unknown or malformed verb"
						end

						t27.not_empty = if v512 == "NOTEMPTY" then 1 else 2
					end

					if t25[1] then
						return "this verb must be placed at the beginning of the regex"
					end
				end
			elseif p66[n1 + 1] == 63 then
				n1 += 2

				if p66[n1] == 35 then
					local v515 = table.find(p66, 41, n1)

					if not v515 then
						return "unterminated parenthetical"
					end

					n1 = v515 + 1
				else
					if not p66[n1] then
						return "unterminated parenthetical"
					end

					t28 = { 40, nil, nil, p66[n1], nil }

					if p66[n1] == 48 and p66[n1 + 1] == 41 then
						t28[1] = "recurmatch"
						t28[2] = 0
						t28[3] = 0
						t28[5] = nil
					elseif p66[n1] > 48 and p66[n1] <= 57 then
						local n4 = n1

						n1 += 1

						while p66[n1] >= 48 and p66[n1] <= 48 do
							n1 += 1
						end

						if p66[n1] ~= 41 then
							return "invalid group structure"
						end

						local v517 = p66.s
						local v518 = utf8.offset(v517, n1)
						local v519 = utf8.offset(v517, n4)
						local v520 = string.sub(v517, v519, v518 and v518 - 1)

						t28[5] = 1
					elseif p66[n1] == 124 then
						t28[5] = n2
					elseif p66[n1] == 80 or p66[n1] == 60 or p66[n1] == 39 then
						if p66[n1] == 80 then
							n1 += 1
						end

						if p66[n1] == 61 then
							local n5 = n1 + 1

							while p66[n1] and (p66[n1] >= 48 and p66[n1] <= 57 or p66[n1] >= 65 and p66[n1] <= 90 or p66[n1] >= 97 and p66[n1] <= 122 or p66[n1] == 95) do
								n1 += 1
							end

								return "unterminated parenthetical"

								return "invalid group structure"

							end

							local n7 = n1 + 1
							local n8 = n1 + 1

							if p66[n8] == 41 then
								return "missing character in subpattern"
							end

							if p66[n8] >= 48 and p66[n8] <= 57 then
								return "subpattern name must not begin with a digit"
							end

							if (not (p66[n8] >= 65) or not (p66[n8] <= 90)) and (not (p66[n8] >= 97) or not (p66[n8] <= 122)) and p66[n8] ~= 95 then
								return "invalid character in subpattern"
							end

							n1 = n8 + 1

							while p66[n1] and (p66[n1] >= 48 and p66[n1] <= 57 or p66[n1] >= 65 and p66[n1] <= 90 or p66[n1] >= 97 and p66[n1] <= 122 or p66[n1] == 95) do
								n1 += 1
							end

								return "unterminated parenthetical"
							end

							if n6 ~= p66[n1] then
								return "invalid character in subpattern"
							end

							local v530 = utf8.offset(v529, n1)
							local v531 = utf8.offset(v529, n7)
							local v532 = string.sub(v529, v531, v530 and v530 - 1)

							n2 += 1

							if (t26[v532] or n2) ~= n2 then
								return "subpattern name already exists"

							for k, v in pairs(t26) do
								if v532 ~= k and n2 == v then

								end

							t28[2] = n2

					elseif not s6[p66[n1]] then

					if t28 then

					end

				end

				continue
			else
				n2 += 1
				t28 = { 40, n2, nil, nil }
			end

			if t28 then
				table.insert(t25, t28)
			end

			n1 += 1

			local n11 = 0

				local u541: boolean = type(t25[n9]) == "table"

				if u541 and v540[1] == 40 then

					if n11 and v540.count then
						n11 += v540.count
					end

					if not v540[3] then
						if v540[4] == 124 then
							local v542 = v540[5]
							local v543 = math.max(n12, n13)

							n2 = v542 + v543
						end

						n10 = if n11 == n10 or n10 == -1 then n11 else nil

						break
					end

					if n9 < 1 then
						break
					end

					continue
				end

				if v540 == t13 then
					if n11 == n10 or n10 == -1 then
						n10 = n11
						n11 = 0
					else
						n10 = nil
						n11 = nil
					end

					n12 = math.max(n12, n13)
					n13 = 0
				elseif n11 then
					n11 = if u541 and v540[1] == "quantifier" then if v540[2] == v540[3] then n11 + v540[2] else nil else n11 + 1
				end

				if n9 < 1 then
					break
				end
			end

			if n9 < 1 then
				return "unmatched ) in regular expression"
			end

			local v544 = t25[n9]
			local t29: {[any]: any} = { 41, v544[2], n9, v544[4], v544[5], count = n10 }

			if (v544[4] == 33 or v544[4] == 61) and v544[5] and not n10 then

	EGAResourceFlowType = gaResourceFlowType,
	EGAProgressionStatus = gaProgressionStatus,
	EGAErrorSeverity = gaErrorSeverity
}

local function addToInitializationQueueByUserId(p2, p3, ...)
	if not module:isPlayerReady(p2) then
		if t6[p2] == nil then
			t6[p2] = {}
		end

		table.insert(t6[p2], {
			Func = p3,
			Args = { ... }
		})
		logger:i("Added event to player initialization queue")

		return
	end

	logger:w("Player initialization queue already cleared.")
end
local function isSdkReady(p4)
	local v39 = p4.playerId or nil
	local v40 = p4.needsInitialized or true
	local v41 = p4.shouldWarn or false
	local v42 = p4.message or ""

	if v40 and not state.Initialized then
		if v41 then
			logger:w(v42 .. " SDK is not initialized")
		end

		return false
	end

	if v40 and v39 and not state:isEnabled(v39) then
		if v41 then
			logger:w(v42 .. " SDK is disabled")
		end

		return false
	end

	if v40 and v39 and not state:sessionIsStarted(v39) then
		if v41 then
			logger:w(v42 .. " Session has not started yet")
		end

		return false
	end

	return true
end

function module.startNewSession(_, p20, p21)
	threading:performTaskOnGAThread(function()
		if not state:isEventSubmissionEnabled() then
			return
		end

		if not state.Initialized then
			logger:w("Cannot start new session. SDK is not initialized yet.")

			return
		end

		state:startNewSession(p20, p21)
	end)
end
function module.endSession(_, p23)
	threading:performTaskOnGAThread(function()
		if not state:isEventSubmissionEnabled() then
			return
		end

		state:endSession(p23)
	end)
end
function module.filterForBusinessEvent(_, p25)
	return string.gsub(p25, "[^A-Za-z0-9%s%-_%.%(%)!%?]", "")
end
function module.addBusinessEvent(_, p27, p28)
	threading:performTaskOnGAThread(function()
		if not state:isEventSubmissionEnabled() then
			return
		end

		if isSdkReady({
			needsInitialized = true,
			shouldWarn = false,
			message = "Could not add business event",
			playerId = p27
		}) then
			local v215 = p28.itemType or ""
			local v216 = p28.itemId or ""
			local v217 = p28.cartType or ""
			local floored = math.floor((p28.amount or 0) * 0.7 * 0.35)
			local v219 = p28.gamepassId or nil

			events:addBusinessEvent(p27, "USD", floored, v215, v216, v217)

			if v215 == "Gamepass" and v217 ~= "Website" then
				local player: Player = players:GetPlayerByUserId(p27)
				local v221 = store:GetPlayerDataFromCache(p27)

				if not v221.OwnedGamepasses then
					v221.OwnedGamepasses = {}
				end

				table.insert(v221.OwnedGamepasses, v219)
				store.PlayerCache[p27] = v221
				store:SavePlayerData(player)
			end

			return
		end

		if p27 then
			addToInitializationQueueByUserId(p27, module.addBusinessEvent, module, p27, p28)

			return
		end

		addToInitializationQueue(module.addBusinessEvent, module, p27, p28)
	end)
end
function module.addResourceEvent(_, p30, p31)
	threading:performTaskOnGAThread(function()
		if not state:isEventSubmissionEnabled() then
			return
		end

		if isSdkReady({
			needsInitialized = true,
			shouldWarn = false,
			message = "Could not add resource event",
			playerId = p30
		}) then
			events:addResourceEvent(p30, p31.flowType or 0, p31.currency or "", p31.amount or 0, p31.itemType or "", p31.itemId or "")

			return
		end

		if p30 then
			addToInitializationQueueByUserId(p30, module.addResourceEvent, module, p30, p31)

			return
		end

		addToInitializationQueue(module.addResourceEvent, module, p30, p31)
	end)
end

function module.addGameAnalyticsTeleportData(_, p65, p66)
	local t9: {[any]: any} = {}

	for _, v in ipairs(p65) do
		local v108 = store:GetPlayerDataFromCache(v)

		v108.PlayerTeleporting = true

		local sessionID = v108.SessionID
		local sessions = v108.Sessions
		local sessionStart = v108.SessionStart
		local text: string = tostring(v)

		t9[text] = {
			SessionID = sessionID,
			Sessions = sessions,
			SessionStart = sessionStart
		}
	end

	p66.gameanalyticsData = t9

	return p66
end

function module.PlayerJoined(_, player)
	local teleportData = player:GetJoinData().TeleportData
	local v123 = nil
	local v124 = store:GetPlayerData(player)

	if teleportData then
		local v125 = teleportData.gameanalyticsData

		if v125 then
			local teleportDataGameanalyticsData = teleportData.gameanalyticsData
			local text: string = tostring(player.UserId)

			v125 = teleportDataGameanalyticsData[text]
		end

		v123 = v125
	end

	local v128 = store:GetPlayerDataFromCache(player.UserId)

	if v128 then
		if v123 then
			v128.SessionID = v123.SessionID
			v128.SessionStart = v123.SessionStart
		end

		v128.PlayerTeleporting = false

		return
	end

	local s1 = "unknown"
	local v130, v131 = postie.invokeClient("getPlatform", player, 5)

	if v130 then
		s1 = v131
	end

	for k, v in pairs(store.BasePlayerData) do
		if not v124[k] then
			if typeof(v) == "table" then
				v124[k] = utilities:copyTable(v)
			else
				v124[k] = v
			end
		end
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return localizationService:GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(player)
	end)

	if ok then
		v124.CountryCode = result
	end

	store.PlayerCache[player.UserId] = v124
	v124.Platform = if s1 == "Console" then "uwp_console" else if s1 == "Mobile" then "uwp_mobile" else if s1 == "Desktop" then "uwp_desktop" else "uwp_desktop"
	v124.OS = v124.Platform .. " 0.0.0"

	if not ok then
		events:addSdkErrorEvent(player.UserId, "event_validation", "player_joined", "string_empty_or_null", "country_code", "")
	end

	local s2 = ""

	if state.UseCustomUserId then
		local v137, v138 = postie.invokeClient("getCustomUserId", player, 5)

		if v137 then
			s2 = v138
		end
	end

	if not utilities:isStringNullOrEmpty(s2) then
		logger:i("Using custom id: " .. s2)
		v124.CustomUserId = s2
	end

	module:startNewSession(player, v123)
	u18 = u18 or replicatedStorage:WaitForChild("OnPlayerReadyEvent")
	u18:Fire(player)

	if state.AutomaticSendBusinessEvents then
		if v124.OwnedGamepasses == nil then
			v124.OwnedGamepasses = {}

			for _, v in ipairs(state._availableGamepasses) do
				if marketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, v) then
					table.insert(v124.OwnedGamepasses, v)
				end
			end
		else
			local t10: {[any]: any} = {}

			for _, v in ipairs(state._availableGamepasses) do
				if marketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, v) then
					table.insert(t10, v)
				end
			end

			local t11: {[any]: any} = {}

			for _, v in ipairs(v124.OwnedGamepasses) do
				t11[v] = true
			end

			for _, v in ipairs(t10) do
				if not t11[v] then
					table.insert(v124.OwnedGamepasses, v)

					local v149 = t1[v]

					if not v149 then
						v149 = marketplaceService:GetProductInfo(v, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
						t1[v] = v149
					end

					local userId = player.UserId
					local priceInRobux = v149.PriceInRobux
					local v152 = module:filterForBusinessEvent(v149.Name)

					module:addBusinessEvent(userId, {
						itemType = "Gamepass",
						cartType = "Website",
						amount = priceInRobux,
						itemId = v152
					})
				end
			end
		end

		store.PlayerCache[player.UserId] = v124
		store:SavePlayerData(player)
	end

	local v153 = t6[player.UserId]

	if v153 then
		t6[player.UserId] = nil

		for _, v in ipairs(v153) do
			v.Func(unpack(v.Args))
		end

		logger:i("Player initialization queue called #" .. #v153 .. " events")
	end
end
function module.PlayerRemoved(_, player)
	store:SavePlayerData(player)

	local v158 = store:GetPlayerDataFromCache(player.UserId)

	if not v158 then
		return
	end

	if not v158.PlayerTeleporting then
		module:endSession(player.UserId)

		return
	end

	store.PlayerCache[player.UserId] = nil
	store.DataStoreQueue.RemoveKey(player.UserId)
end
function module.isPlayerReady(_, p79)
	if store:GetPlayerDataFromCache(p79) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end
function module.ProcessReceiptCallback(_, p81)
	local u163 = t1[p81.ProductId]

	if not u163 then
		pcall(function()
			u163 = marketplaceService:GetProductInfo(p81.ProductId, Enum.InfoType.Product)
			t1[p81.ProductId] = u163
		end)
	end

	if u163 then
		local playerId = p81.PlayerId
		local currencySpent = p81.CurrencySpent
		local v166 = module:filterForBusinessEvent(u163.Name)

		module:addBusinessEvent(playerId, { itemType = "DeveloperProduct", amount = currencySpent, itemId = v166 })
	end
end
function module.GamepassPurchased(_, player, p84, p85)
	local v171 = t1[p84]

	if not v171 then
		v171 = marketplaceService:GetProductInfo(p84, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
		t1[p84] = v171
	end

	local n1 = 0
	local s1 = "GamePass"

	if p85 then
		n1 = p85.PriceInRobux
		s1 = p85.Name
	elseif v171 then
		n1 = v171.PriceInRobux
		s1 = v171.Name
	end

	local userId = player.UserId
	local v175 = module:filterForBusinessEvent(s1)

	module:addBusinessEvent(userId, {
		itemType = "Gamepass",
		amount = n1 or 0,
		itemId = v175,
		gamepassId = p84
	})
end

local t8: {[any]: any} = { "gameKey", "secretKey" }

function module.initServer(_, p87, p88)
	module:initialize({ gameKey = p87, secretKey = p88 })
end
function module.initialize(_, p90)
	threading:performTaskOnGAThread(function()
		for _, v in ipairs(t8) do
			if p90[v] == nil then
				logger:e("Initialize '" .. v .. "' option missing")

				return
			end
		end

		if p90.enableInfoLog ~= nil and p90.enableInfoLog then
			module:setEnabledInfoLog(p90.enableInfoLog)
		end

		if p90.enableVerboseLog ~= nil and p90.enableVerboseLog then
			module:setEnabledVerboseLog(p90.enableVerboseLog)
		end

		if p90.availableCustomDimensions01 ~= nil and #p90.availableCustomDimensions01 > 0 then
			module:configureAvailableCustomDimensions01(p90.availableCustomDimensions01)
		end

		if p90.availableCustomDimensions02 ~= nil and #p90.availableCustomDimensions02 > 0 then
			module:configureAvailableCustomDimensions02(p90.availableCustomDimensions02)
		end

		if p90.availableCustomDimensions03 ~= nil and #p90.availableCustomDimensions03 > 0 then
			module:configureAvailableCustomDimensions03(p90.availableCustomDimensions03)
		end

		if p90.availableResourceCurrencies ~= nil and #p90.availableResourceCurrencies > 0 then
			module:configureAvailableResourceCurrencies(p90.availableResourceCurrencies)
		end

		if p90.availableResourceItemTypes ~= nil and #p90.availableResourceItemTypes > 0 then
			module:configureAvailableResourceItemTypes(p90.availableResourceItemTypes)
		end

		if p90.build ~= nil and #p90.build > 0 then
			module:configureBuild(p90.build)
		end

		if p90.availableGamepasses ~= nil and #p90.availableGamepasses > 0 then
			module:configureAvailableGamepasses(p90.availableGamepasses)
		end

		if p90.enableDebugLog ~= nil then
			module:setEnabledDebugLog(p90.enableDebugLog)
		end

		if p90.automaticSendBusinessEvents ~= nil then
			module:setEnabledAutomaticSendBusinessEvents(p90.automaticSendBusinessEvents)
		end

		if p90.reportErrors ~= nil then
			module:setEnabledReportErrors(p90.reportErrors)
		end

		if p90.useCustomUserId ~= nil then
			module:setEnabledCustomUserId(p90.useCustomUserId)
		end

		if isSdkReady({ needsInitialized = true, shouldWarn = false }) then
			logger:w("SDK already initialized. Can only be called once.")

			return
		end

		local gameKey = p90.gameKey
		local secretKey = p90.secretKey

		if not validation:validateKeys(gameKey, secretKey) then
			logger:w("SDK failed initialize. Game key or secret key is invalid. Can only contain characters A-z 0-9, gameKey is 32 length, secretKey is 40 length. Failed keys - gameKey: " .. gameKey .. ", secretKey: " .. secretKey)

			return
		end

		events.GameKey = gameKey
		events.SecretKey = secretKey
		state.Initialized = true
		players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
			module:PlayerJoined(player)
		end)
		players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
			module:PlayerRemoved(player)
		end)

		for _, v in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
			coroutine.wrap(module.PlayerJoined)(module, v)
		end

		for _, v in ipairs(t5) do
			task.spawn(v.Func, unpack(v.Args))
		end

		logger:i("Server initialization queue called #" .. #t5 .. " events")
		t5 = nil
		events:processEventQueue()
	end)
end

if not replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GameAnalyticsRemoteConfigs") then
	local gameAnalyticsRemoteConfigs: RemoteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")

	gameAnalyticsRemoteConfigs.Name = "GameAnalyticsRemoteConfigs"
	gameAnalyticsRemoteConfigs.Parent = replicatedStorage
end

if not replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("OnPlayerReadyEvent") then
	local onPlayerReadyEvent: BindableEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

	onPlayerReadyEvent.Name = "OnPlayerReadyEvent"
	onPlayerReadyEvent.Parent = replicatedStorage
end

task.spawn(function()
	local timestamp = os.time()
	local floored = math.floor(timestamp / 3600)

	t2 = store:GetErrorDataStore(floored)

	while true do
		if not task.wait(3600) then
			break
		end

		local timestamp2 = os.time()
		local floored2 = math.floor(timestamp2 / 3600)

		t2 = store:GetErrorDataStore(floored2)
		t3 = {}
		t4 = {}
	end
end)
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if not task.wait(store.AutoSaveData) then
			break
		end

		for _, v in pairs(t4) do
			local v187 = t3[v]

			t3[v].countInDS = store:IncrementErrorCount(t2, v, v187.currentCount - v187.countInDS)
			t3[v].currentCount = t3[v].countInDS
		end
	end
end)

local function ErrorHandler(p93, p94, p95, player)
	local s1 = "(null)"

	if p95 ~= nil then
		s1 = p95
	end

	local s2 = "(null)"

	if p93 ~= nil then
		s2 = p93
	end

	local s3 = "(null)"

	if p94 ~= nil then
		s3 = p94
	end

	local s4 = s1 .. ": message=" .. s2 .. ", trace=" .. s3

	if #s4 > 8192 then
		s4 = string.sub(s4, 1, 8192)
	end

	local UserId = nil

	if player then
		UserId = player.UserId
		s4 = s4:gsub(player.Name, "[LocalPlayer]")
	end

	local v197 = s4

	if #v197 > 50 then
		v197 = string.sub(v197, 1, 50)
	end

	if t3[v197] == nil then
		t4[#t4 + 1] = v197
		t3[v197] = {}
		t3[v197].countInDS = 0
		t3[v197].currentCount = 0
	end

	if t3[v197].currentCount > 10 then
		return
	end

local function mul(p24, p25, p26, p27)
	local v448 = table.create(p27)
	local n1 = 0
	local n2 = 0
	local n3: number = 1

	for i = 1, p27 do
		local v453 = math.max(1, i + 1 - #p25)
		local v454 = math.min(i, #p24)

		for j = v453, v454 do
			n1 += p26 * p24[j] * p25[i + 1 - j]
		end

		local n4 = n1 % 16777216

		v448[i] = math.floor(n4)
		n1 = (n1 - n4) / 16777216
		n2 += n4 * n3
		n3 *= 16777216
	end

	return v448, n2
end

		return p3
	end

		return p3
	end

		return p3
	end

	end

	end

		n3 = v11
	end

	local function widgetEventInteractivity()
		p1.CollapsingHeader({ "Widget Event Interactivity" })

			local v87 = v81:get()

		end

			p1.Text({ "Here i am!" })
		end

		p1.End()
		p1.Separator()

		local v88 = p1.State(0)

			v88:set(20)
		end

		if v88:get() > 0 then
			p1.Text({ "Here i am!" })
		end

		p1.End()

		local v89 = v88:get()
		local v90 = math.max(0, v89 - 1)

		v88:set(v90)
		v86 = p1.Text

		local v91 = v88:get()

		v86({ "Text Timer: " .. v91 })

		p1.Indent()

	local function tablesDemo()

		p1.End()
		p1.Table({ 3 })

		for i = 1, 4 do
			p1.NextRow()

			for j = 1, 3 do
				p1.NextColumn()
				p1.Text({ (("Row: %*, Column: %*"):format(i, j)) })
			end
		end

		p1.End()
		p1.Text({ "" })
		p1.SameLine()
		p1.Text({ "Table using NextColumn only syntax:" })
		helpMarker("only calling Iris.NextColumn() in the inner loop, the result is identical")
		p1.End()
		p1.Table({ 2 })

		for i = 1, 4 do
			for j = 1, 2 do
				p1.NextColumn()
				p1.Text({ (("Row: %*, Column: %*"):format(i, j)) })
			end
		end

		p1.End()
		p1.Separator()

		local v116 = p1.State(false)
		local v117 = p1.State(false)
		local v118 = p1.State(true)
		local v119 = p1.State(true)

		p1.Text({ "Table with Customizable Arguments" })

			[p1.Args.Table.BordersOuter] = v117.value,
			[p1.Args.Table.BordersInner] = v118.value
		})

		for i = 1, v120:get() do
			for j = 1, 4 do
				p1.NextColumn()

				if v119.value then
					p1.Button({ (("Month: %*, Week: %*"):format(i, j)) })
				else
					p1.Text({ (("Month: %*, Week: %*"):format(i, j)) })
				end
			end
		end

		p1.End()

	local function updateActiveDrag()
		local x = p2.getMouseLocation().X
		local n5 = x - n1

		n1 = x

		if u11 == false then
			return
		end

		if u12 == nil then
			return
		end

		local v74 = u12.state.number

		if s1 == "Color3" or s1 == "Color4" then
			v74 = u12.state.color

			if n2 == 4 then
				v74 = u12.state.transparency
			end
		end

		local v75 = u12.arguments.Increment and getValueByIndex(u12.arguments.Increment, n2, u12.arguments) or t4[s1][n2]
		local n6: number = if not p2.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) and not p2.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) then 1 else 10
		local n3: number = if not p2.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt) and not p2.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt) then 1 else 0.1
		local n4 = getValueByIndex(v74.value, n2, u12.arguments) + n5 * (v75 * n6 * n3 * (if s1 == "Color3" or s1 == "Color4" then 5 else 1))

		if u12.arguments.Min ~= nil then
			n4 = math.max(n4, getValueByIndex(u12.arguments.Min, n2, u12.arguments))
		end

		if u12.arguments.Max ~= nil then
			n4 = math.min(n4, getValueByIndex(u12.arguments.Max, n2, u12.arguments))
		end

		v74:set(updateValueByIndex(v74.value, n2, n4, u12.arguments))
		u12.lastNumberChangedTick = p1._cycleTick + 1
	end
	local function DragMouseDown(p25, p26, p27, p28, p29)
		local v84 = p2.getTime()
		local u85: boolean = v84 - p25.lastClickedTime < p1._config.MouseDoubleClickTime
		local isKeyDown = p2.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or p2.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)

		if u85 and (Vector2.new(p28, p29) - p25.lastClickedPosition).Magnitude < p1._config.MouseDoubleClickMaxDist or isKeyDown then
			p25.state.editingText:set(p27)

			return
		end

		p25.lastClickedTime = v84
		p25.lastClickedPosition = Vector2.new(p28, p29)
		u11 = true
		u12 = p25
		n2 = p27
		s1 = p26
		updateActiveDrag()
	end

	local function generateColorDragScalar(p42, ...)

					else
						p43.arguments.Format = { "%d" }
					end

					p43.arguments.Prefix = t2[p42 .. (if p43.arguments.UseHSV then "_HSV" else "_RGB")]

				p43.arguments.Min = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
				p43.arguments.Max = { 1, 1, 1, 1 }
				p43.arguments.Increment = { 0.001, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001 }

				if p43.state then
					p1._widgets[p43.type].UpdateState(p43)
				end
			end,
			GenerateState = function(p44)
				if p44.state.color == nil then
					p44.state.color = p1._widgetState(p44, "color", t8[1])
				end

				if p42 == "Color4" and p44.state.transparency == nil then

				end

				if p44.state.editingText == nil then
					p44.state.editingText = p1._widgetState(p44, "editingText", false)
				end
			end
		})

	local u8 = nil
	local u9: boolean = false
	local u10: boolean = false
	local u11: boolean = false
	local top = Enum.TopBottom.Top
	local left = Enum.LeftRight.Left
	local u14 = nil
	local u15 = nil
	local u16: boolean = false
	local t1: {[any]: any} = {}

	local function quickSwapWindows()
		if p1._config.UseScreenGUIs == false then
			return
		end

		local n1 = 65535
		local v34 = nil

		for iterFirst, iterSecond in t1, nil, nil do
			if iterSecond.state.isOpened.value and not iterSecond.arguments.NoNav and iterSecond.Instance:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local displayOrder = iterSecond.Instance.DisplayOrder

				if n1 > displayOrder then
					n1 = displayOrder
					v34 = iterSecond
				end
			end
		end

		if v34.state.isUncollapsed.value == false then
			v34.state.isUncollapsed:set(true)
		end

		p1.SetFocusedWindow(v34)
	end
	local function fitSizeToWindowBounds(p6, p7)
		local vector2 = Vector2.new(p6.state.position.value.X, p6.state.position.value.Y)
		local n1 = (p1._config.TextSize + p1._config.FramePadding.Y * 2) * 2
		local v42 = p2.getScreenSizeForWindow(p6)
		local vector22 = Vector2.new(p1._config.WindowBorderSize + p1._config.DisplaySafeAreaPadding.X, p1._config.WindowBorderSize + p1._config.DisplaySafeAreaPadding.Y)
		local n2 = v42 - vector2 - vector22
		local vector2New = Vector2.new
		local x = p7.X
		local v47 = math.max(n2.X, n1)
		local v48 = math.clamp(x, n1, v47)
		local y = p7.Y
		local v50 = math.max(n2.Y, n1)
		local v51 = math.clamp(y, n1, v50)

		return vector2New(v48, v51)
	end
	local function fitPositionToWindowBounds(p8, p9)
		local instance = p8.Instance
		local v55 = p2.getScreenSizeForWindow(p8)
		local vector2 = Vector2.new(p1._config.WindowBorderSize + p1._config.DisplaySafeAreaPadding.X, p1._config.WindowBorderSize + p1._config.DisplaySafeAreaPadding.Y)
		local vector2New = Vector2.new
		local x = p9.X
		local vector2X = vector2.X
		local v60 = math.max(vector2.X, v55.X - instance.WindowButton.AbsoluteSize.X - vector2.X)
		local v61 = math.clamp(x, vector2X, v60)
		local y = p9.Y
		local vector2Y = vector2.Y
		local v64 = math.max(vector2.Y, v55.Y - instance.WindowButton.AbsoluteSize.Y - vector2.Y)
		local v65 = math.clamp(y, vector2Y, v64)

		return vector2New(v61, v65)
	end
	function p1.SetFocusedWindow(p10)
		if p10 == u15 then
			return
		end

		if u16 and u15 ~= nil then
			if t1[u15.ID] then
				local windowButton = u15.Instance.WindowButton
				local windowButtonTitleBar = windowButton.TitleBar

				if u15.state.isUncollapsed.value then
					windowButtonTitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = p1._config.TitleBgColor
					windowButtonTitleBar.BackgroundTransparency = p1._config.TitleBgTransparency
				else
					windowButtonTitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = p1._config.TitleBgCollapsedColor
					windowButtonTitleBar.BackgroundTransparency = p1._config.TitleBgCollapsedTransparency
				end

				windowButton.UIStroke.Color = p1._config.BorderColor
			end

			u16 = false
			u15 = nil
		end

		if p10 == nil then
			return
		end

		u16 = true
		u15 = p10

		local instance = p10.Instance
		local instanceWindowButton = instance.WindowButton
		local titleBar = instanceWindowButton.TitleBar

		titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = p1._config.TitleBgActiveColor
		titleBar.BackgroundTransparency = p1._config.TitleBgActiveTransparency
		instanceWindowButton.UIStroke.Color = p1._config.BorderActiveColor
		n1 += 1

		if p10.usesScreenGUI then
			instance.DisplayOrder = n1 + p1._config.DisplayOrderOffset
		end

		if p10.state.isUncollapsed.value == false then
			p10.state.isUncollapsed:set(true)
		end

		if not p2.GuiService.SelectedObject then
			return
		end

		if titleBar.Visible then
			p2.GuiService:Select(titleBar)

			return
		end

		p2.GuiService:Select(instance.ChildContainer)
	end

	p2.UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, p12)
		if not p12 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			p1.SetFocusedWindow(nil)
		end

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab and (not not p2.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or not not p2.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)) then
			quickSwapWindows()
		end

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and u10 and not u11 and u16 and u15 then
			local n1 = p2.getMouseLocation() - (u15.state.position.value + u15.state.size.value * 0.5)
			local n2 = math.abs(n1.X) * u15.state.size.value.Y
			local absoluteValue = math.abs(n1.Y)

			if n2 >= absoluteValue * u15.state.size.value.X then
				top = Enum.TopBottom.Center
				left = if math.sign(n1.X) == -1 then Enum.LeftRight.Left else Enum.LeftRight.Right
			else
				left = Enum.LeftRight.Center
				top = if math.sign(n1.Y) == -1 then Enum.TopBottom.Top else Enum.TopBottom.Bottom
			end

			u9 = true
			u8 = u15
		end
	end)
	p2.UserInputService.TouchTapInWorld:Connect(function(_, p14)
		if not p14 then
			p1.SetFocusedWindow(nil)
		end
	end)
	p2.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if u6 and u5 then
			local vector2

			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				local inputPosition = input.Position

				vector2 = Vector2.new(inputPosition.X, inputPosition.Y)
			else
				vector2 = p2.getMouseLocation()
			end

			local windowButton = u5.Instance.WindowButton
			local v83 = fitPositionToWindowBounds(u5, vector2 - u7)

			windowButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v83.X, v83.Y)
			u5.state.position.value = v83
		end

		if u9 and u8 and u8.arguments.NoResize ~= true then
			local v84 = u8.Instance.WindowButton
			local vector2 = Vector2.new(v84.Position.X.Offset, v84.Position.Y.Offset)
			local vector23 = Vector2.new(v84.Size.X.Offset, v84.Size.Y.Offset)
			local v87 = if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then input.Delta else p2.getMouseLocation() - u14
			local vector24 = Vector2.new(if left == Enum.LeftRight.Left then v87.X else 0, if top == Enum.TopBottom.Top then v87.Y else 0)
			local vector25 = Vector2.new(if left == Enum.LeftRight.Left then -v87.X else if left == Enum.LeftRight.Right then v87.X else 0, if top == Enum.TopBottom.Top then -v87.Y else if top == Enum.TopBottom.Bottom then v87.Y else 0)

			vector25 = fitSizeToWindowBounds(u8, vector23 + vector25)

			local v90 = fitPositionToWindowBounds(u8, vector2 + vector24)

			v84.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vector25.X, vector25.Y)
			u8.state.size.value = vector25
			v84.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(v90.X, v90.Y)
			u8.state.position.value = v90
		end

		u14 = p2.getMouseLocation()
	end)
	p2.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, _)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and u6 and u5 then
			local windowButton = u5.Instance.WindowButton

			u6 = false
			u5.state.position:set(Vector2.new(windowButton.Position.X.Offset, windowButton.Position.Y.Offset))
		end

		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and u9 and u8 then
			u9 = false
			u8.state.size:set(u8.Instance.WindowButton.AbsoluteSize)
		end

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX then
			quickSwapWindows()
		end
	end)
